This taught me that we must always treat everyone with respect, even strangers.

Furthermore, your initial actions show the world who you truly are. Not long ago, there was a shocking story on the news about a woman who went into a grocery store, licked a tub of ice cream from the freezer, and put it back without paying. This single act completely ruined her public reputation. She brought shame not only upon herself but also upon her family and her country. Once people see you behave this way, it is impossible to change their opinion of you.

Of course, some might argue that first impressions can be corrected because people can change. However, this is rarely true in reality because people's initial perceptions of you tend to stick. Even if you try to act differently later on, others might just think you are having an unusual day rather than believing you have genuinely changed. Depending on the gravity of your first mistake, people will likely continue to view you through that original lens.

In conclusion, the character, attitude, and behavior you display when you first meet someone are incredibly difficult to redefine. First impressions are lasting and rarely offer a way back. Therefore, we must ask ourselves: when we meet someone new, will we choose to be respectful and responsible, or will we face the permanent consequences of a bad first impression?

Dear Principal, I am writing to share my thoughts on the proposal to introduce a healthier school lunch menu. I believe that updating our menu is an excellent idea because it will reduce the amount of junk food students eat, help them maintain good health, and inspire them to make better dietary choices.

Currently, many students eat unhealthy meals at school almost every day. Switching to a nutritious menu will significantly lower their consumption of junk food. Eating poorly on a daily basis can harm students in various ways, potentially leading to serious conditions like early obesity or heart issues. Furthermore, this change would not only benefit the student body but also help teachers and school staff eat healthier meals during the workday.

A healthier menu would also support students' physical development by providing the essential proteins and nutrients they need. Consequently, this can boost their performance both in their academic classes and in sports. Additionally, a new menu gives everyone a chance to try different dishes instead of eating the same repetitive meals year after year. This change will help students realize that the new menu is not a punishment, but rather a positive step to keep them healthy.

Although some students might initially dislike the idea because their favorite unhealthy foods will be removed, I believe it will be highly beneficial in the long run. It will encourage them to develop healthy eating habits that will serve them well now and in the future. Moreover, it might motivate them to persuade their friends and families to eat better, protecting their loved ones from illnesses associated with a poor diet.

In conclusion, I strongly support replacing our current school lunch options with a healthier menu. It will limit junk food consumption, improve overall health, and promote better lifestyle choices. I hope these points help you see how this change can make our school a much better place. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Students should be allowed to use their mobile phones for educational purposes because these devices make completing schoolwork much easier. For instance, phones can serve as calculators in math class or as research tools in history class. Additionally, teachers can design phone-based activities to keep students more engaged. Ultimately, having access to their phones helps students become more active participants in their own learning.

In math class, cellphones can be highly beneficial. If a student's regular calculator runs out of battery, their phone can serve as a reliable backup so they can finish their assignments. Students can even use the straight edge of their phone as a quick ruler to draw neat lines and save time. Furthermore, teachers can allow students to take photos of the whiteboard, ensuring they remember what their homework is for the next day. In these ways, phones are a great tool during critical moments in math class.

Similarly, cellphones offer great advantages in history class when used correctly. Teachers can direct students to specific websites to research historical dates and find answers. If a student has to leave school early, they can quickly photograph the board to copy the notes into their notebook later. Teachers can also introduce fun, interactive games like Kahoot to make the lesson more exciting. Moreover, students can watch programs like CNN 10 on their phones to stay informed about current global events.

Of course, some people disagree with allowing phones in the classroom. Critics argue that mobile devices are a major distraction and that students should rely on traditional books to find information. Others worry that phones make it easier for students to cheat on tests and quizzes. However, these concerns do not apply to everyone, as many students can use their devices responsibly.

In conclusion, permitting cellphones for educational purposes can significantly improve the learning experience. When teachers integrate phones into their lessons, it encourages better interaction and makes school more enjoyable. Students will feel more enthusiastic about learning, especially when participating in activities like Kahoot. By embracing this technology, we can make education both more effective and fun.

People who value independence and self-reliance should still consult experts and authorities when making major life decisions, rather than relying solely on themselves. Experts are individuals who possess much more knowledge about a specific subject than we do. We can compare this relationship to that of a teacher and a student. Teachers, for instance, have studied deeply to master their subjects, such as science. They put in a lot of effort to earn their qualifications. Similarly, to succeed in life, self-reliant people need the guidance of specialists. Of course, there are some personal choices we can make entirely on our own. For example, deciding whether to smoke or drink alcohol is a personal choice where we only affect our own bodies. If we do not look after ourselves, no one else will. However, for major life choices, expert advice is essential.

In my view, self-reliance is a crucial quality for everyone to develop. However, being self-reliant is ultimately about making the right choices. Since no human is perfect, we are all prone to making mistakes. This is especially true during our teenage years, a period when we are highly vulnerable to outside influences and need guidance more than ever. During this stage, parents are the best experts we can turn to. Because they love us and want us to succeed, they can teach us what truly matters in life. While some parents may not be as supportive, many genuinely care about their children's future. In addition to parents, we can also seek advice from professionals who hold degrees in their respective fields. Because they have spent years studying, their professional guidance can help us make better decisions and grow as individuals.

Making poor decisions can have devastating consequences on our lives. We all have to make choices, but some decisions that seem attractive at first can lead to serious trouble. For instance, someone might decide to invest their savings into opening a restaurant. On the surface, this looks like a great business opportunity where one can only make a profit. However, the reality of running a business is highly challenging. Many people fail to consider the hidden costs, taxes, and bills they must pay from their earnings. They do not realize they could lose their entire investment if the business fails. Such financial ruin can lead to severe depression and, in extreme cases, even suicide. This is why we need business experts instead of making these huge decisions alone. These professionals have degrees in business and understand the market, allowing them to guide us toward success and protect our money.

Some people might argue that making decisions independently is better because it teaches us to take responsibility for our actions, and we cannot blame others if things go wrong. While learning from our own mistakes is valuable, we do not have to experience failure first-hand to learn. It is much wiser to consult experts beforehand to avoid making harmful mistakes in the first place. After all, two heads are better than one.

In conclusion, seeking advice from experts is the most effective way to navigate life's challenges. Specialists and experienced guides exist to help us make informed choices. We must accept that we cannot do everything on our own and that asking for help from parents or professionals is a sign of strength, not weakness. To achieve success, we should utilize different resources, be open to communication, and consult others to ensure we make the best possible decisions.

For instance, when a phone rings, it interrupts the whole class because everyone stops to see whose phone it is. This makes it difficult for your classmates to understand the material they need to succeed in the future. You should not prevent your peers from achieving their goals just because you are distracted.

Students should not ignore their teachers or use their devices for personal entertainment during lessons. Phones should only be allowed when they serve a clear educational purpose. Ultimately, just because some students do not care about their education does not mean they should ruin the opportunities of others. This is why cellphones should be banned from the classroom.

As a member of the Generic_City school community, I have noticed that many students are changing their minds about the upcoming changes to our cafeteria menu. The school has recently decided to introduce healthier lunch options by removing some popular but unhealthy foods and offering better meat alternatives. I believe this transition is an excellent idea because it will raise awareness about nutrition and help students build healthier bodies.

Adopting a healthier diet encourages students to rethink their daily routines and food choices. It can motivate them to participate in sports, just like student-athletes, and inspire them to prioritize their well-being. By eating more fruits, vegetables, and dairy products, students will become more comfortable with nutritious diets. This lifestyle shift often leads to regular exercise at the gym, helping them develop a fit and strong physique.

Furthermore, poor eating habits can lead to physical and social difficulties, including isolation, as we grow into adulthood. Implementing this new menu will help lower the risk of developing serious illnesses like cancer and heart disease, which are often caused by a lack of nutritional knowledge. Staying active and flexible is essential for a good quality of life. Statistics show that many young people suffer from premature heart attacks due to the harmful ingredients found in junk food, making this change crucial.

My main reason for supporting this initiative is the overall importance of nutrition. Eating well actually boosts brainpower, allowing students to focus better in class and improve their academic performance. Additionally, a healthy diet enhances physical appearance, making people look more attractive and confident, while giving them much more energy and strength in their daily lives.

In conclusion, while some students support this new cafeteria policy, others remain critical of it. However, I strongly advocate for this change and will continue to help my peers understand the vital benefits of healthy eating.

Is Ralph Waldo Emerson correct in his assertion? He once wrote that we cannot grow unless we attempt to do things that go beyond what we have already mastered. I completely agree with this view because it encourages individuals to strive for greater achievements in their lives. Furthermore, this idea prompts people to reflect on their personal goals and consider whether they should push past their current limits. There are several reasons why Emerson's perspective is highly accurate.

A motivating statement like this can open people's eyes, encouraging them to target ambitious goals and challenge boundaries they previously thought were impossible to cross. With this mindset, individuals begin to believe they can exceed their own expectations. In contrast, those who give up too easily often stop trying to reach their potential, leaving them unsure of what they want or what they are truly capable of achieving.

This continuous learning process builds a strong mindset and a more rewarding lifestyle. In conclusion, Emerson's statement remains a vital guide for personal development and stands as one of the most inspiring quotes of all time. Although fear prevents many people from reaching for higher standards, overcoming this fear and gaining new experiences will always lead to a better and more successful life.

This essay explores the different aspects of working in a team compared to working alone. The focus of this analysis is on how these methods affect the individual person, rather than the group as a whole. First, we will examine the relationship between the individual and the group. Then, we will look at the various challenges of teamwork and how these factors can either help or hinder a person's progress.

Think back to the last time you had to complete a project. You probably considered several ways to approach it. One of the first decisions you had to make was whether to work by yourself or join a group. While everyone understands what it means to complete a task alone, understanding what a group is and how it functions is more complex.

A group can be defined as a gathering of individuals who cooperate to achieve a specific goal. Group dynamics refers to how these groups are structured, how they form, and how they operate. This concept is important for both formal and informal teams. Because groups are so common in any organization, studying how they function is a key part of understanding organizational behavior.

When looking at group dynamics, we focus on the reasons why groups are created and how they evolve over time. Researchers have developed various theories to explain these processes.

Although working in a team has many advantages, it also has some disadvantages. For instance, individuals usually have less control over the final outcome compared to when they work alone. Furthermore, some team members might dominate the project, while others remain passive. In these situations, the group might complete the task, but some members miss out on learning. On the other hand, successful collaboration can produce much better results than working individually. It allows people to combine different skills and share ideas, which helps everyone gain a deeper understanding of the topic.

Being part of a team also helps you improve your communication skills, such as listening and speaking. Additionally, it builds essential teamwork abilities like leadership and the capacity to motivate others. These skills are highly valuable and will be useful throughout your academic and professional life.

To make the most of these advantages, it is essential to manage your group work in an effective way.

Many people believe that working in a team is the best way to achieve results, but working individually is actually much more advantageous. When you work by yourself, you can stay calm and avoid constant interruptions. You do not need to ask for anyone else's approval, which is especially helpful for introverted people who feel uncomfortable in crowds. Although group work allows people to share different perspectives, working independently remains the superior choice.

Professional life is already full of pressure, and having colleagues constantly talking and sharing opinions only increases this stress. In a noisy group environment, a stressed person cannot relax or think of creative solutions. Consequently, they will probably go home feeling much more exhausted than someone who spent their day working in a quiet, solitary space. Being alone helps people relax, and a calm mind is essential for generating great ideas.

Furthermore, working alone is a great way to save time. When a new idea comes up in a group, you have to present it to everyone and wait for their agreement, which is a very slow process. Often, people disagree, leading to endless debates, confusion, and wasted time. On the other hand, independent workers can immediately implement their ideas and focus on their tasks instead of spending hours discussing opinions. This efficiency allows everyone to get more work done.

Working in a team can also be extremely difficult for shy individuals. For introverts, collaborating with others is a constant struggle because they feel forced to speak up and share their thoughts. This pressure makes it hard to focus, as they often worry that others are judging their work. To avoid conflict, shy people might simply agree with the group's decisions instead of sharing their own valuable ideas. This anxiety prevents the brain from functioning properly, which can result in poor quality work.

Of course, some argue that teamwork is beneficial because it allows people to share diverse perspectives and find new opportunities. While sharing ideas is useful, the benefits of working alone are far greater. It is much better to have a peaceful workday than to go home feeling overwhelmed by group dynamics. Ultimately, working individually in a quiet environment allows you to analyze your thoughts and focus deeply. This calm, stress-free experience is exactly what everyone needs to succeed.

Technology has always acted as a compelling and mysterious field for me. Even as a child, I spent countless hours not playing my video-game consoles as intended, but rather meticulously studying every component of the device in an attempt to crack the mystery on how it operated. Despite the fact that I've grown older and many aspects of my life have changed, my passion for technology has not only remained, but undoubtedly grown stronger as well. Therefore, an internship in this field seems vital in feeding and nurturing this passion. Although I have not had previous experience in shadowing, an opportunity to shadow would be fitting due to my previous experience and ever-growing passion in this field.

My experience in the technological field proves fitting for this opportunity to shadow. In school, I am enrolled in the Center for Information Technology at Generic_School. This specialty center provides me with crucial access to exclusive technology-based courses and teachers that help me broaden my vision in the technology field. Classes such as IT Project Management, Programming, and AP Computer Science Principles are all courses that I have been graciously provided with through the center and received exceptional results in. This daily involvement in technology not only increased my knowledge in this field, but also my curiosity on the subject. Outside of school, I am a member of the Technology Student Association, a club dedicated to assisting students nurture their interests through rigorous competitions. Through this club I have been able to surround myself with peers with similar interests and aspirations. This club has also provided me with opportunities to exhibit my knowledge in the technological field through competitions, receiving first place in States in Mass Production, Junior Solar Sprint, and Biotechnology. My involvement and superior results in these events prove to show not only my interest in this field, but my capabilities as well. These experiences transfer directly over to the internship, allowing for a smooth transition without much confusion.

The passion I have for technology undeniably proves me to be fitting for this internship opportunity. A crucial action that proves my strong interest in technology occurred when high school specialty center results were published. I was accepted into the medical, IB, and the information technology centers. Despite the fact that the majority of my close friends chose to enroll into the medical center, I stuck with my passion and enrolled into the Information Technology center. The action of choosing my interest over my close friends of many years displays how much I value technology and wish to pursue it in the future. In addition, my strong passion for technology can be displayed through the utilization of my free time. While other kids may choose to spend this time by indulging themselves into video games, much of my time is spent educating myself on technology. Many enjoyable hours of activities such as reading on the history of computers or watching videos on the future of technology were spent during this time. This use of my limited free time shows that technology, in my mind, is not a merely a class in school, but rather a hobby or an enjoyable subject. This attitude would no doubt have a beneficial effect for the internship.

In conclusion, the heavy interest and years of experience I have in technology proves me to be exceptional candidate for this shadowing opportunity. Although my work experience is limited, my passion and expierence in technology may help me ease into the internship without trouble. The talent I have in technology mixed with the catalyst that is my preexisting passion for this field helps me understand the importance of this internship. Not only will this internship assist in broadening my horizons on technology, but it will also help nurture and grow this passion into something meaningful and of use to the real world. Therefore, I believe this internship is perfect for me.

Is setting an example by your own behavior the best way to influence other people? Sometimes it is not the best idea to mirror other people's behavior because some people do not always have a positive behavior. There could be time's that someone could be in a negative place of mind, reckless, and does a lot of horse play; other time's people can be charming, properly mannered, and influential.

Growing up in the Generic_City area, I have been able to witness a lot of drugs, gangs, and violence. The example these group of people decide to display is not a very positive act on their behalf; this is not a pathway you would want to be taking because of the bad outcomes from it. I remember I had a friend who's father shot himself due to the poor choice he made which made him reflect and he figured that was the only solution.

On the other hand, some people decide to be very influential to society in a positive manner. Out of my three years of high school I was able to see some students making their way for others by not being selfish; a lot of them did volunteer work as well to help the community and to hopefully inspire others to do so as well. I actually got the opportunity to throw a kids halloween party at a church: I enjoyed it, it was a lot of fun.

Honestly, I do not feel like I am a good example nor do I feel like I am a bad one either. I make mistakes: it is how I was taught. Growing up I believed that the only way you are ever going to learn is by making mistakes and being able to evaluate the error of your mistake; only then you can truly improve yourself and help insipre other people as well.

In conclusion, I am mutual about examples being the best way to influence other people because of it not always being a positive thing due to the poor decisions some people choose to make. Truthfully I think it is a better idea to be the best you that you can be because at the end of the day there is only one of you and so many of us; it is best to stay unique.

I completely agree with Emerson's statement because staying true to yourself is incredibly important. Showing your authentic self is what makes life beautiful, as it allows us to connect with all kinds of unique personalities. Unfortunately, the world today can be very harsh. People often bully others for simple things like their clothes, shoes, or physical appearance. This constant judgment makes many victims dislike themselves and try to become someone they are not just to escape the pain.

I experienced this firsthand during a difficult time in my life when I fell into depression. I was constantly teased for being too skinny and having a large head. Although I can laugh about it now, back then it was painful enough that I stopped wanting to go to school or even leave my house. Fortunately, a close friend noticed my absence and asked what was wrong. When I opened up to him, he told me to ignore the bullies and focus on enjoying my life. We have been best friends ever since. Later, I also talked to my mother about it. She reminded me that life is too short to let negative people stop me. This conversation completely changed my perspective on life.

Today, staying true to yourself is extremely challenging. A simple negative comment about someone's shoes can deeply affect their self-esteem. To fit in with the popular crowd, people start buying expensive things they do not even like or doing things they do not want to do, sometimes even turning to bad behavior. Ultimately, the fear of judgment prevents people from showing their true selves.

We need to offer more support to those going through these struggles. People should be encouraged to love themselves and embrace who they are. Cruel words can have devastating consequences, sometimes even driving victims to suicide. To prevent this, society needs to promote respect, and parents should teach their children to respect others from a young age. We must learn to ignore other people's negative opinions and live our lives to the fullest.

In the end, being yourself in today's society is a huge achievement. While negative comments can make you feel worthless, facing this negativity is a normal part of life that can actually make you stronger and wiser. Overcoming these challenges should motivate you to succeed and make your loved ones proud. Standing firm in who you are is truly the greatest accomplishment.

Since most dogs love going for walks, the park is the perfect destination to spend some quality bonding time with your furry friend.

Another great option is having a picnic with your friends or family. Sharing a meal outdoors is highly enjoyable because it allows you to chat and eat together in a relaxed setting. Picnics are especially pleasant on warm, sunny days when the weather is beautiful. After finishing your meal, you can walk around and explore the rest of the park. If you invite someone who has never visited before, they might fall in love with the place and want to return in the future.

Additionally, some parks feature animals that visitors can observe. It is fascinating to see creatures like bears, fish, turtles, goats, chickens, and pigs, and you might even get to watch pig races. You might even discover species you have never seen in person before. Often, park staff are available to teach you interesting facts about these animals, such as their origins and diets. In some cases, you can even feed them using food provided by the park.

Finally, parks are excellent places to ride bikes, skateboards, and scooters. It is a safe environment to practice and learn how to ride because there are no cars around. Riding through the park allows you to enjoy the lovely scenery while staying active. Because parks are much safer than busy streets and offer plenty of open space, they are ideal spots to hang out and ride around with your friends.

Most high school students choose to complete the traditional four years of school. This path allows them to apply for college during their senior year while receiving valuable guidance from their teachers and counselors. Finishing high school early can be very challenging for teenagers because everyone learns at a different pace. While school districts should give students the freedom to decide their own future, the traditional four-year plan is often better. It helps students avoid the intense pressure and anxiety of rushing, and it gives them the chance to take elective classes.

Every student knows how important it is to pass classes and earn enough credits to graduate. However, trying to graduate early can be risky because it often causes severe anxiety and pressure. This combination of stress and rush can easily lead to mental health issues for teenagers. Furthermore, many parents constantly monitor grades, which can create a frustrating environment. When students struggle under this pressure, their guardians might restrict their freedom or take away important personal items, making their lives even more difficult to manage.

Although the fear of getting bad grades or falling behind is common among all students, those who choose the four-year path usually worry less. To graduate early, teachers often advise students to take extra courses during the summer or in the evenings. In contrast, staying in school for the full four years means you do not have to do this extra work. While you still have to complete your regular assignments, you can do them at a comfortable pace without feeling rushed. Ultimately, students should be responsible for their own learning, even if it takes them a bit longer.

High schools also offer the opportunity to explore new subjects through elective courses. Students who follow the traditional four-year plan can easily choose these classes to challenge themselves and develop new skills. Unfortunately, those who try to graduate early do not have this luxury, as they cannot afford to spend time on classes that are not strictly required for graduation.

In conclusion, completing the traditional four years of high school is a much better option for most teenagers. This path ensures they can get continuous support from their teachers and school staff when they need it. High levels of anxiety and pressure only distract students from learning effectively. Teenagers already have enough homework, so they should not have to spend their free time on extra courses. Ultimately, having the time to take elective classes is highly beneficial, as it allows students to learn fun new activities and take a break from their core academic subjects.

Winston Churchill once suggested that transitioning from failure to success is a challenging journey. Many people agree with this perspective because achieving career goals and finding success is never easy. We all make mistakes, and not everyone succeeds right away. However, people must keep trying, even if it takes years of effort. Failure is not the end of the road; rather, it is an opportunity for individuals to discover what they are best at and realize their potential to achieve their goals.

To begin with, many people believe that overcoming failure is a valuable experience. For instance, some friends once told a peer that basketball was not the right sport for him. However, through continuous practice, his skills improved significantly, proving that practice makes perfect. Similarly, my sister dreamed of attending the University of Virginia (UVA). Although our family doubted she would be accepted, she studied incredibly hard and received her acceptance letter a few weeks later. These examples show that while life is not easy, we can succeed if we are willing to work harder.

Furthermore, facing difficulties is a universal human experience. No one goes through life without facing obstacles. In school, for example, almost every student struggles with their classes at some point. Nobody is born intelligent; we must work hard to develop our minds. Personally, while I get good grades in Math and History, I struggle more with English and Science. This shows that everyone has unique strengths and weaknesses. Since nobody is perfect, we simply need to study and put in the effort to improve.

On the other hand, some people argue that trying to turn failure into success is a waste of time and does not benefit their future careers. They feel overwhelmed by the massive amount of information they must learn in school, college, or at work. Additionally, they complain about the heavy burden of working just to pay for housing, bills, health insurance, and car insurance. However, those who view self-improvement as pointless often end up struggling significantly in life, sometimes even facing homelessness or a lack of purpose.

Ultimately, striving to overcome failure and achieve success is essential because it builds self-esteem. When people accomplish their career goals early, they can enjoy their lives later without constant worry. Studying and learning new things allows us to reach our full potential. Even if we do not succeed immediately, we always have another chance as long as we keep working hard, ensuring we will have no regrets in the future.

I believe that every person in this world has the power to choose their own character traits. However, many people are easily influenced by those around them, including friends, family, and even strangers who do not want to see them succeed and try to hold them back. On the other hand, individuals who decide to follow their own positive traits usually achieve a much better and more successful life. Ultimately, not everyone has a negative impact on you; some people can be a good influence and guide you in the right direction. In the end, it all depends on your own mind and how you decide to process what is good or bad for your future.

To begin with, everyone starts life with different circumstances and traits. Some people develop negative traits because they did not grow up in a happy family environment, which affects how they behave. Conversely, those raised in loving households often learn positive traits and values. However, even if you have a good upbringing, your character can still be ruined if you choose to spend your time with people who have bad habits and negative attitudes.

Furthermore, our traits directly affect our success in life. People who achieve great success, such as owning beautiful houses and expensive cars, usually have positive traits that help them secure a better life for the next generation. In contrast, negative traits lead to a difficult and unsuccessful life. If you associate with negative people, you risk letting them control and influence your behavior. Relationships can also have a massive impact on your character. For example, a bad romantic relationship filled with constant arguments, blame, and emotional hurt can leave deep scars that create negative traits for your future. Conversely, a healthy relationship can guide you in the right direction.

Finally, strong and intelligent people do not let others control them. When you are successful, jealous people may try to pull you down and ruin your progress. It is crucial to stand up for yourself and stay away from these toxic influences. My advice to anyone who feels controlled by others is to remember that you are the creator of your own character. The traits you choose will define how you live, so you must reflect on your choices and decide whether you want to live a positive or a negative life.

Many students who graduate early choose to head straight to college. However, I believe it is much better for students to finish high school in three years and spend a year working before starting higher education. Taking this path allows them to save money, grow more mature, and develop essential time-management skills, opening up many valuable opportunities before they begin their studies.

First of all, working for a year gives students a great chance to save money for their education. Many students have to take out student loans because they lack funds and their parents cannot afford to support them. However, these loans must be repaid with interest after graduation. By finishing high school in three years, students can work to fund their own education, avoiding debt and relieving their parents of financial stress. This experience teaches young people to rely on themselves and take responsibility, which demonstrates maturity and makes their families proud.

Secondly, entering the workforce helps students mature because they learn to be independent and gain a better understanding of the real world. Students who graduate early are often only 17 years old. Spending a year working helps them grow up while earning money. This maturity is crucial for college, where they must meet strict deadlines set by professors. Being mature helps them transition into adulthood, earning them respect from others. Furthermore, starting college at 18 instead of 17 means they will enter at the same age as their peers, reducing the risk of being singled out or feeling isolated.

Finally, many students struggle with submitting their schoolwork on time. Having a job teaches excellent time-management skills because employees must arrive on time, complete tasks promptly, and avoid being late. These skills are highly beneficial in college, helping students attend classes punctually, submit assignments on time, and maintain a healthy sleep schedule. Time management is not just about deadlines; it is also about creating a balanced daily routine for studying, working, socializing, and resting. Once students establish these habits through work, they will easily handle the demands of college life without feeling overwhelmed.

Although some people argue that high school graduates should transition immediately to college, I believe that those who do not take time to mature first will struggle significantly. Working beforehand provides invaluable opportunities that prepare students for the challenges ahead. In conclusion, taking a year to work after graduating early equips students with the tools they need to succeed. They will not have to worry about heavy student debt, they will possess superior time-management skills, and they will have developed the maturity and independence required to handle college life successfully.

Many people desire independence because they want to start making their own choices. Being able to make your own decisions is a major milestone in life, as it demonstrates responsibility and maturity. However, people can make either positive or negative choices. When people make poor decisions, it can lead to serious consequences and cause significant harm to those around them.

Some common examples of destructive choices include using drugs, driving under the influence of alcohol, and joining gangs. Becoming part of a gang carries a high risk of losing your life for no good reason, which only brings immense grief to the people who love you. Similarly, drunk driving endangers not only your own life but also the lives of innocent people who have families waiting for them at home. If you choose to drive after drinking, you have to live with the guilt of putting others in the hospital. Finally, drug abuse is highly damaging, and the best way to avoid addiction is to never start. These negative choices ultimately disappoint and hurt your family and friends.

On the other hand, making positive decisions helps you plan your life after high school. This includes choosing a career path, deciding what to study in college, or planning to start a family. These are all excellent choices for building a successful future. Finding a good job can be difficult without prior experience, but going to college first allows you to gain the specific knowledge needed for your desired career. This preparation helps you secure a stable job, which in turn provides the financial security needed to support a family without constant worry.

As young people grow up, they naturally want to practice being independent and making their own choices. During this transition, parents begin to realize that their children can handle things on their own without constant guidance. This shift shows parents that their kids are maturing into responsible adults. By allowing teenagers to make their own decisions, parents help them learn to think critically and develop as individuals. It also proves to parents that their children can take care of themselves when they are alone.

In conclusion, making decisions can be a difficult challenge, but it is an essential part of becoming an independent adult. It is a necessary step that everyone must take to move forward in life. Ultimately, independence is something that many people strive for, and once you achieve it, the choice of how to use it is up to you.

I strongly disagree with the proposal to extend the school day. Currently, the number of hours we spend in school is already sufficient. If the school board decides to add another hour and a half to our daily schedule, students will become extremely exhausted, making it difficult for them to absorb information effectively. The combination of longer school hours and daily homework would create too much pressure. For many students, the current workload is already stressful enough. Adding more time would likely cause them to dislike school, lose interest in their education, or even drop out. Furthermore, students would have very little time left to study for exams or complete major projects at home, which is especially problematic for those who work part-time jobs.

In addition, young people need free time to maintain their happiness and physical health. As a middle school student, I am currently able to balance my schoolwork and my personal life quite well. However, if an hour and a half is added to the schedule, I am not sure if I will still have enough time to relax, complete my assignments, and spend quality time with my family and friends. A lack of free time to play or enjoy hobbies would definitely harm my well-being. For students who have part-time jobs, this change would make it nearly impossible to rest or connect with loved ones. Their mental and physical health would suffer because they would not have the time to exercise or do fun activities to clear their minds.

This schedule change would also negatively affect teachers, many of whom hold part-time jobs to support their families or save money because their teaching salaries are not enough. It would be extremely difficult for them to teach effectively while managing another job. Teachers are already required to stay after school once or twice a week to help struggling students or supervise test retakes. If the school day is extended, they will not have enough time for their second jobs or to care for their families, whether that means looking after their children or supporting their elderly parents. Consequently, teachers would either be forced to quit their profession or the school board would have to increase their salaries so they would not need extra jobs.

Another major concern is safety, particularly regarding school bus transportation. Drivers already face risks when driving in the dark early in the morning, and navigating a bus full of students with low visibility is very challenging. Adding an hour and a half to the day would make the afternoon commute much later. The situation becomes even worse when considering after-school programs. These programs usually last for two hours, meaning students would head home three and a half hours later than usual. By that time, it would be completely dark outside, making the drive highly dangerous for both the bus drivers and the students on board.

Finally, the after-school program itself, which is highly beneficial, would be at risk of closing. This program is essential because it allows students to catch up on missing assignments, retake tests, improve their grades, and complete community service hours. Unfortunately, schools might have to cancel these programs if the school day is extended. It would simply be too demanding for teachers, bus drivers, and students. By the time the regular school day ended, students would be far too exhausted to stay any longer, making the program unsustainable.

Scientist Albert Einstein once said, "Imagination is more important than knowledge." Now imagine yourself as a beginning engineer, sitting at your desk, aggravated because you can't come up with a new invention. All you have around you are textbooks but no image or thought of what your invention may be. If only you could imagine a new invention of some sort then maybe you could build something. But with no imagination, how can you build knowledge? I agree with Einstein's quote. I believe imagination is more important than knowledge.

I agree with Einstein's quote because having imagination is how we've had all our inventions yet. Without imagination how were many of the things we own invented? For example, the telephone. The telephone couldn't have been invented without someone imagining a device where you could communicate without leaving your home. You need imagination in order to make new things. Another example would be the camera. Whoever invented it, had to have imagination in order to think of a device that captures any moment almost in an instant. Even I, as a student, need imagination in order to make new things. For example, when making an essay, such as this one, I need to imagine of a good story hook that goes along with the prompt.

Furthermore, I believe in Einstein quote because without imagination, knowledge is almost useless. For example, when learning a new vocabulary list. You may know all the definitions but you can't put them in your own words or use the words in different instances. Why? Because you can't imagine it. You can't picture it, you just know the definitions. Another example is when reading a book. Knowing how to read isn't even near of what you need to fully comprehend a book. You need to imagine it. Picture the story in your mind in order to fully understand the book's theme, setting and tone.

Lastly, I agree in Einstein's quote because without imagination, all our decisions would be made carelessly. For instance, before you speak or move, most of the time you imagine what the outcome of that action will be. If not, the outcome won't be for the better. Another instance is when in an experiment, you hypothesize what the result of the experiment will be. That takes imagination. When signing a contract, it's needed to imagine the consequences of signing and not signing the contract. In other words, you need to imagine things before you decide to take them on. Knowledge isn't the only thing that will help you when making decisions.

In conclusion, Einstein's quote is correct in my perspective. Knowledge isn't the most important factor to have, imagination is key to everything you do and will do. You can't fully understand most things without imagining them. Can't go on inventing things before imagining them first. Also, you won't be able to make good decisions before imagining the outcome. All in all, imagination is also how you'll enjoy your life. Knowledge is great and all but it can't bring others as much happiness as imagination can. It's how we've been happy for all these years. Imagination is how we have gone so far in this world and how much we've survived.

The famous scientist Albert Einstein once remarked, "Imagination is more important than knowledge." Picture a novice engineer sitting at a desk, feeling frustrated because they cannot invent anything new. They are surrounded by textbooks, but they lack a clear vision or idea of what to create. Without a spark of imagination, it is impossible to build anything, regardless of how much information is available. Therefore, I completely agree with Einstein's statement. Imagination is indeed more valuable than mere knowledge.

First of all, imagination is the driving force behind every invention in human history. Without it, the everyday items we rely on would not exist. For instance, the telephone could never have been created if someone had not first imagined a device that allowed people to talk to each other from the comfort of their own homes. Similarly, the inventor of the camera had to visualize a machine capable of capturing a single moment in time instantly. Even as a student, I need to use my imagination regularly. For example, when writing an essay like this one, I must imagine an engaging hook to capture the reader's attention and match the prompt.

Furthermore, knowledge is practically useless if we do not have the imagination to apply it. Consider the process of learning new vocabulary words. You might memorize all the definitions, but you will struggle to use them in different contexts or put them into your own words if you cannot visualize their meaning. Another example is reading a novel. Simply knowing how to read words is not enough to truly appreciate a book. You must imagine the story in your mind to fully comprehend the setting, the characters, and the overall message of the author.

Additionally, imagination plays a crucial role in making wise decisions. Before we speak or act, we usually imagine the potential consequences of our choices to avoid making mistakes. In science, formulating a hypothesis for an experiment requires us to imagine what the results might be. Similarly, before signing a contract, a person must visualize the long-term outcomes of both signing and refusing to sign. Ultimately, knowledge alone is not enough to guide us through life's choices; we must be able to foresee the results of our actions.

In conclusion, I believe Einstein was absolutely right. Knowledge is important, but imagination is the key to everything we do. It allows us to understand the world, invent new technologies, and make thoughtful decisions about our future. Moreover, imagination is what brings joy and happiness to our lives, helping humanity progress and survive throughout history. While having knowledge is beneficial, it is our imagination that truly allows us to move forward and enjoy life to the fullest.

Let us begin with a crucial question that many of us rarely stop to consider: "How is technology affecting our physical and mental health?" This is one of the most important questions of our modern era, and it is an issue that we cannot afford to leave unanswered.

Today, technology is deeply woven into the fabric of our daily routines. From the moment we wake up in the morning until we fall asleep at night, we constantly interact with various digital devices, applications, and online tools. This digital shift allows us to complete numerous daily tasks without having any physical contact with other human beings. For instance, people can now borrow books, shop for groceries, and play video games without ever speaking to another person. However, this severe reduction in face-to-face human contact has had a highly negative impact on our lives.

To understand this issue better, we can compare two different types of people. The first person relies entirely on technology for almost everything: they shop online, do their homework on a computer, play video games, and communicate with friends or family members only through screens. This individual is much more likely to experience physical illness, chronic pain, or depression compared to someone who chooses to do things in the real world. The second person prefers to avoid technology when possible; instead, they walk to the store to buy clothes, visit the library for books, and meet their family members in person to see how they are doing. The heavy technology user is far more likely to get sick or suffer from pain because devices encourage a highly sedentary lifestyle. Spending hours sitting in front of screens frequently leads to poor posture, neck strain, back problems, and even hearing loss. These physical issues can quickly turn into chronic discomfort that is very difficult to treat.

Returning to our initial question about how technology impacts our health, it becomes clear that the effects are rarely positive. Constant device use causes high levels of stress, damages our eyesight, and leads to physical ailments like back pain and hearing difficulties. Furthermore, the lack of real-world interaction is a major cause of mental health issues like depression. When people spend all their time on their devices, they often fail to build real friendships because they stay isolated at home. It is scientifically proven that every human being needs social connections and friends to talk to when they are feeling down or going through a difficult time. Without these personal relationships, heavy technology users often feel lonely and lose the desire to interact with the people around them.

In conclusion, while technology makes it easy to complete tasks without human contact, this convenience comes at a very high cost to our well-being. If we do not learn to manage our screen time, future generations will suffer from these exact same problems. Unfortunately, we live in a society where technological progress is the norm, and it would take a miracle to reverse this situation. However, to prevent this crisis from getting worse, individuals must learn how to balance their time. By limiting our technology use and focusing more on real-life interactions, we can protect ourselves from physical pain, illness, and depression.

When you make a firm decision to do something, you gain a clear direction for your future. For instance, if you decide to get in shape, you might spend two hours at the gym daily or go jogging every morning. As a result, you will lose weight and achieve a healthy body. Similarly, determination helps you reach your goals when facing difficulties. If a high school senior is struggling with grades but wants to graduate, they can ask teachers and friends for help, or study online and practice at home. By doing this every day, they will improve their grades and successfully graduate.

Furthermore, being active makes your time feel much more valuable. When you finally accomplish your goals after working hard, you feel proud and satisfied. The effort you put in makes the time spent truly worthwhile. This process also teaches you patience. You will keep pursuing your dreams even when you face difficult challenges in life. Consequently, you not only achieve your goals but also develop a stronger character.

On the other hand, being lazy and having no determination can make a person unproductive. Without action, you will have no job, no money, and no future. For example, if you want to buy a house but have no money, doing nothing instead of finding a job will only waste your time and bring no benefits. Additionally, idleness causes you to lose the respect of others. While those around you are working hard and succeeding, you will be left behind in failure.

Fortunately, finding direction in life is not difficult. Creating a to-do list is a simple way to start. It helps you organize your tasks, accomplish more of your goals, and ultimately become a successful person.

If students and staff are completely exhausted at the end of a long day, they might fall asleep while driving, which could lead to dangerous car accidents. We already see too many accidents on the roads, and making people drive while exhausted will only make this problem worse.

Ultimately, almost no one would agree to work longer hours when it poses such a high risk to their health. Our bodies are not designed to handle that level of physical and mental exhaustion, and risking our well-being is simply not worth it. Personally, I would refuse to overwork myself in this way because it would make me sick. Since our bodies cannot cope with this extreme pressure, extending the school day is definitely a bad decision.

I believe that students should be allowed to choose their own elective classes rather than being forced into specific arts courses. When schools assign students to classes they know nothing about, they are setting them up to fail, which is not how education should work. Students need to have something positive to look forward to when they come to school each day. While taking creative subjects like music, drama, or art is important, it is only fair to let students make their own decisions. When students select their own classes, they feel excited and motivated to attend school every day, which helps them succeed.

On the other hand, if counselors place students in classes they dislike, those students will likely skip those lessons. Instead, we should encourage them to find the classes that truly fit their interests. I strongly urge school administrators to take action and give students the freedom to make these choices for themselves.

In conclusion, offering students this choice will increase their satisfaction and bring new energy to the school. By making their own decisions, students will stay positive, get better grades, and take a major step toward achieving their future goals.

Everything you can do while playing an instrument is enjoyable. Some things are more enjoyable than others like being able to listen to yourself making good music, going on fun field trips, and being able to find all different types of music.

Hearing your class play well makes you confident that your concert will sound great. It feels good to know that you're capable of playing music that others who aren't able to do. It's always nice to know that you can achieve the level that you want to achieve. The opportunities you get while playing an instrument are endless.

Every field trip is a gift to the students who play their instruments from the school. Some places that schools go to are Kings Dominion, Busch Gardens, Hershey Park, and many more exciting places. Those all have roller coasters, water activities, and carnival games, who wouldn't want to go there.

First impressions are our natural way of reacting to new people and situations, whether they make us feel scared, amused, or something else. These initial feelings are nearly impossible to alter because they happen instantly and automatically. Since they come naturally from within us, we have no control over them. Our minds generate these thoughts immediately, catching us completely unprepared. Therefore, once a first impression is formed, it cannot be easily changed.

To begin with, first impressions are a natural human response that we cannot control. For instance, whenever we meet someone new, we instantly form an opinion about them, no matter who they are. This reaction happens completely on its own. Similarly, when people travel or move to a different part of the country, they automatically get a certain feeling about each new place they visit. Another example can be seen in schools. At the start of the academic year, students quickly develop impressions about their new classes before they even have time to think about them deeply, and they cannot easily change these initial thoughts.

Secondly, our minds play a crucial role in creating first impressions by processing information and sending these thoughts to us. For example, when people go grocery shopping, they compare prices between different supermarkets. Their minds quickly analyze this data and send them immediate impressions about which store offers better value. In a different setting, healthcare professionals working in hospitals with cancer patients have minds that are trained to handle difficult situations. Their brains quickly form and deliver impressions based on how they are prepared to react to these serious environments. Finally, when immigrants move to the United States, their minds undergo a massive adjustment. The brain does the heavy work of forming new impressions to help them adapt to a completely different lifestyle.

Furthermore, people are usually unprepared for first impressions, which means these feelings always arrive as a surprise while we discover new things. For example, when we go to the cinema to watch a new movie, we might only have a vague idea of what it is about. As soon as the film starts, we immediately begin to form impressions without even realizing it. Another example is when young people turn 18. They are often unprepared to live independently, and they suddenly realize how difficult life can be with new responsibilities and without their parents' constant help. Lastly, when starting a new job, employees must learn new tasks. They quickly form impressions about the difficulty of the work, which they were not prepared for while they were still learning.

In conclusion, first impressions are almost impossible to change because they are a natural and instant reaction to the world around us. Our minds do the main work of generating these immediate thoughts and sending them to us. Additionally, because we are never truly prepared for these feelings, they always come as a surprise when we experience something new. Ultimately, as we explore life, first impressions will always appear automatically.

Staying true to yourself helps you become the best version of who you are. When you are authentic, you do not have to pretend to be someone else. While personal growth is a natural part of life, you should never lose your core personality and attitude just to fit in or become a worse version of yourself. Many people choose to change because they want to improve or because they want to be less shy. However, altering your true nature is a complex process, and trying to go back to who you used to be can be very difficult once you have started changing your habits.

First of all, being yourself allows you to express your unique identity. You do not need to alter your personality just to impress other people. Deep down, our basic traits are hard to change because they are a fundamental part of who we are. Of course, significant life events can force people to change. For instance, experiencing the loss of a loved one, dealing with abuse, or struggling with depression can make someone lose their sense of self. When you decide to make a change, it can be a major adjustment for your family, who are already accustomed to your usual behavior. Therefore, if you do decide to change, you should aim to become a better person rather than a worse one, so you do not give people a reason to speak negatively about you. Ultimately, you should not worry too much about what others think, because your identity belongs to you alone.

Secondly, trying to change for the wrong reasons can cause you to lose your inner self. You might have spent years developing a personality that you actually respect. If you want to make a change, you should do it for your own sake, not to please your friends, because they may not care about your true self in the long run. Your actions should reflect your genuine goodness. I remember my grandmother once telling me to always be myself and never change for anyone else, because nobody will love and respect me as much as my family does. You should not suppress your true self; even if you have flaws or can be annoying at times, your family will still value you. No one should feel forced to change just because others criticize them. It is important to reveal your true character, even if you have been hiding it. Sometimes, people will try to bring you down or encourage others to dislike you simply because you are quiet or different. Despite this, you should remain unique and show everyone that you are content with who you are.

Thirdly, your personality is a direct reflection of your character. Nobody enjoys being around arrogant people who act as if they are superior to everyone else. It is always best to be honest about your background, even if you come from a humble or poor home. Staying humble shows that you do not care about superficial opinions and that you are comfortable in your own skin. You should avoid changing into someone you will eventually regret becoming. For example, if a friend or a relative stops speaking to you, you should not react by becoming bitter or mean, as this will only push them further away. At the same time, you should not be too stubborn to listen to constructive advice from people who genuinely want to help you grow. It is much better to stand out for being an authentic individual rather than someone who simply copies others just to become popular or well-known.

Fourthly, reverting to your original self after you have already changed can be incredibly difficult. Once you have pushed away your old habits, returning to them after a long time is a slow and complicated process. Furthermore, the people who distanced themselves from you during your transition might never return to your life. The choices you made to alter your personality can have permanent consequences that cannot easily be undone. Therefore, if you made a conscious decision to change for the better, you should not try to go back to your old self just because you are struggling with your current identity. Since you chose to improve for a reason, you should embrace this new version of yourself and move forward. The person you choose to become today will likely be the person you remain as you grow older.

In conclusion, you should always strive to be yourself instead of pretending to be someone you are not. Staying true to your identity will benefit you throughout your entire life. If you ever feel the need to make changes, make sure you do it for your own personal growth and not to please people who do not deserve your efforts. By being unique and authentic, you will naturally attract positive people who want to be around you. Ultimately, being true to yourself now will shape the kind of independent adult you will become when you finally leave home and start your own life.

Technology is undoubtedly one of the greatest achievements of the modern era. Almost everyone enjoys using it, but is it truly as wonderful as it seems? During my childhood, older generations often warned that technology would eventually destroy our social lives. Back then, I did not believe them, but today I finally understand what they meant.

At its core, the main purpose of technology is to simplify daily tasks, not to make us inactive or antisocial. Unfortunately, we are not using this powerful tool to its full potential. Instead of using it to make our lives easier, we misuse it. For example, rather than cooking healthy meals at home, we use apps to order fast food, which is much unhealthier. Furthermore, many people have built their entire lives around digital devices, feeling completely lost without them. The widespread use of social media on smartphones has also discouraged real-world interactions, as people now prefer online chatting to face-to-face conversations.

On the other hand, technology certainly has its advantages. Its biggest benefit is saving time during everyday activities. In the past, people had to send physical letters, which took days or weeks to arrive. Today, we can send messages instantly. Additionally, technology allows us to create eco-friendly homes, cars, and airplanes that run on electricity instead of damaging fossil fuels. We can generate clean electricity using solar panels, wind turbines, and water power. This renewable energy is virtually limitless, unless an extreme global catastrophe occurs, such as the sun disappearing or water completely evaporating. Until then, we can rely on these green technologies to protect our planet.

Despite its drawbacks, technology remains an incredible invention for humanity. The negative effects can actually be managed quite easily if we change our habits. We simply need to stop centering our lives around social media and treat technology as a secondary tool for communication. It is amazing to see how far technology has progressed. It started with simple inventions like the light bulb, but now it powers our vehicles, homes, smartphones, and entire cities. Almost everything built by humans today relies on some form of technology.

In conclusion, while these impressive innovations have captured our attention, they have also isolated us from one another. Technology is a brilliant creation, but it poses a serious threat to our social well-being. Humans are naturally social creatures, and suppressing this fundamental need will lead to negative consequences. We have evolved over thousands of years to connect with others, and trying to change this natural behavior is dangerous. Ultimately, technology brings many benefits to our lives, but improving our social connections is definitely not one of them.

They believe that failing to reach a difficult goal can make someone lose hope and stop trying altogether, leaving them feeling empty and reluctant to try again. Accomplishing these various steps, rather than just a single easy task, makes people feel proud and satisfied with their progress. Even if they fail to reach one specific target, it does not mean they cannot succeed at others. While it is impossible to accomplish every single goal, aiming high pushes people to complete difficult tasks they might have otherwise avoided.

In addition, setting high goals helps individuals feel much more successful. Reaching a challenging milestone greatly boosts self-confidence and reduces anxiety about future challenges. It proves to people that they are capable of doing much more than they initially thought. This newfound confidence is highly beneficial for the future, as it prepares them to face new opportunities with courage. By aiming high, people feel that they are making meaningful progress in their lives rather than feeling like they have accomplished nothing.

When a person concentrates on a significant objective, this focus provides them with the mental energy and drive needed to keep going. In conclusion, aiming high is incredibly beneficial because it fosters motivation, success, and greater achievement. No one is perfect, and people must overcome their fears of failing in order to reach their full potential and accomplish their dreams.

Students work hard there is no arguing that. They have schoolwork, homework, extracurricular and maybe work, all these things make a students life stressful so it is important that they get a break every once in a while. I believe that students should get a long summer break, instead of a year-round school year, because, firstly, there are other activities that can be done during the summer that keep students minds active, secondly their health is at risk and lastly, summer break is beneficial to school staff as well.

From time to time, people need to get a break from their day-today life they need to take a moment to relax and enjoy their life and maybe discover an interest that they may have. Although school is important and necessary for success later on in life, so are outside experiences that can contribute to the development of a student's 'real life skills'. During summer break there are multiple activities that can be done in order to keep a student's mind active, whether it may be sports, summer camps, summer jobs etc. All these activities allow for their minds and bodies to stay active. Eventhough, they are not keeping their brains engaged in terms of school work and studying they are exposing themselves to new activities that might require them to think critically, open-mindedly and collaboratively; which I feel is essential for real life. For example, a student might be at summer camp and they are put in a group with four strangers and are given a challenging task that requires them to collaborate with the other member of the group, critically analyzing the situation and coming up with solutions and be open-minded to listening and trying to understand the perspectives of their peers. This also reflects their environment in school therefore, it can be said that they are keeping their minds active while outside of school.

Although, not all students might be involved in activities outside of school, some are taking a break from the stress of life itself. Due to all the demands in their life during the school year summer break is a good way to take a breather and take care of themselves mentally. Depression has been very common in teenagers in recent years, and although it may not be entirely due to the stress of school, school does contribute to the detirriation of their mental health. In addition, over-working ones self has negative impacts overall whether they are depressed or not. Too much stress in ones life can have negative effects on their health overall. High blood pressure, hypertension, severe weight loss are a few examples of the effects stress. Furthermore, when stressed our body releases a neurotransmitter called Cortisol, this neurotransmitter in excess can impair a persons thinking and reaction time; which is very important for students as they are required to think in order to complete school work and homework, therefore, if they dont take breaks their grades are probably going to drop due to their inability to think effectively, further contributing to their detirriating mental health.

Lastly, summer break is and essential time for everyone that is involved in schools, such as teachers, administrators, councilors etc. Although schools are intended to educate students, its the school staff that make this possible. Many people are familiar with Michelangelo's famous words: "The greater danger for most of us lies not in setting our aim too high and falling short; but in setting our aim too low, and achieving our mark." Although some might disagree, aiming high is ultimately much better for us. When we set ambitious goals, we are able to achieve much greater things. High expectations encourage creative thinking, whereas aiming too low limits our minds. Furthermore, striving for more opens up a wide range of exciting possibilities in life.

For instance, consider job hunting: is it better to apply only for an easy job like washing dishes, or to apply for various positions across different fields? The same logic applies to education. A student who is unsure about their future might choose to join the military, or they could go to college where they will have many more options. Choosing college increases their career opportunities and helps them find a more satisfying job in the long run.

Additionally, aiming high helps people discover their true potential and think more creatively, unlike those who set low targets and limit their minds. People who aim low often hide or ignore their own abilities because they avoid difficult challenges. In contrast, those who set high standards try to solve harder problems, which stimulates their brains and helps them think outside the box. Great artists, for example, would never have produced their masterpieces if they had limited themselves. Their unique ideas and beautiful creations exist precisely because they refused to set boundaries and aimed as high as possible.

In addition, aiming high allows us to accomplish much bigger goals than if we simply choose the easiest path to guarantee success. For example, if you are working on a school assignment, will you get a better grade by doing the bare minimum or by putting in the maximum effort? The answer is clearly the latter. If you set low standards, you are more likely to give up when faced with a difficult but important task. On the other hand, a high goal motivates you to persist and succeed. Therefore, aiming high is always better than just doing the easiest thing possible.

On the other hand, some might argue that setting extremely high goals can lead to unnecessary suffering and stress. While this can happen, it does not mean we should aim too low. The key is to find a healthy balance. Just as we are taught to eat a balanced diet as children, we must balance our ambitions by understanding our true abilities and aiming for what is challenging yet possible, rather than what is merely easy. Others might believe that aiming low reduces stress because you do not have to work as hard. However, not all stress is harmful; sometimes it can actually motivate us. Returning to school and facing challenges actually helped me. While stress can be negative, it can also have positive effects on our lives.

Aiming low may seem safe and simple, but the real danger is that we forget our potential and stop believing we can achieve great things. We should make decisions that we will not regret and set the highest goals we can. No one needs to be perfect, but we should all try our best during our short lives so that we can look back with no regrets.

Many people believe that first impressions are permanent and nearly impossible to alter. However, I strongly disagree with this idea. In my opinion, the way people perceive us can definitely change over time. This is because people naturally mature as they grow up, they are influenced by those around them, and they are shaped by the difficult experiences that life throws at them.

To begin with, first impressions change as individuals mature. As we grow older, our behavior and appearance naturally transform. For instance, my mother often points out how much I have changed compared to when I was a child. When I was seven or eight years old, I was extremely shy and always tried to avoid any trouble. However, growing up has made me much more confident. If people never changed, they would still act exactly as they did in childhood. Therefore, as we mature, the way others see us inevitably changes too.

Additionally, our impressions can change because of the influence of the people around us. We often adapt our behavior by watching others. For example, my younger brother used to be incredibly quiet and hesitant to speak. However, after observing how I interacted with people—with confidence, courage, and a calm attitude—he began to copy me. Now, he is outgoing and easily talks to anyone. This shows that the people in our lives can have a major impact on us, changing how we behave and how others perceive us.

Finally, unexpected life events can completely alter how people see us. A clear example of this happened just before my fourteenth birthday when my father was arrested. I was devastated and felt that life was completely unfair. Before this event, my classmates always saw me as a cheerful, happy teenager. However, when they tried to wish me an early happy birthday, they noticed I was miserable and distracted. Their impression of me changed instantly. Instead of joking around, they started giving me space because they realized I was depressed. Since then, people have started taking me more seriously. This proves that difficult life experiences can quickly change the image we present to others.

In conclusion, the belief that first impressions are permanent is incorrect. People's initial opinions of us can easily change over time. This is because personal maturity, the influence of family, and sudden life challenges all play a significant role in shaping who we are. Ultimately, we cannot predict how these factors will transform us, but they certainly prove that first impressions are never set in stone.
