In modern society, many people believe it is better to set simple goals that are easy to achieve rather than aiming high and risking failure. However, I disagree with this view. The famous artist Michelangelo once suggested that the greatest danger for most of us is not that our aim is too high and we miss it, but that it is too low and we reach it. He understood this because he faced many failures before becoming a successful artist. Like Michelangelo, I believe that aiming high and failing is far better than choosing an easy path. This is because big goals teach us to learn from our mistakes, encourage us to take risks, and ultimately help us grow as individuals.

To begin with, pursuing ambitious goals allows us to learn from our failures and improve. When we make mistakes, we can analyze what went wrong and practice to do better next time. For instance, on the cooking show Masterchef, contestants try to impress the judges with their culinary skills, but one person is sent home in each episode. Although getting eliminated can be heartbreaking, these chefs show great courage by continuing their journey and learning from their errors. Another example is my own experience taking the driving permit test as a teenager. This test is a major milestone for young people. The first time I took it, I was extremely nervous and failed by just one question. Instead of giving up, I studied the questions I got wrong and passed easily on my second attempt. These examples show that failure helps us gain resilience and learn valuable lessons.

In addition, aiming high teaches us how to take risks, which is essential for major life decisions regarding our careers and education. Even if these risks do not always pay off immediately, they are still more valuable than playing it safe. For example, on the television show Shark Tank, entrepreneurs pitch their ideas to investors. Many of them leave without a deal, but they do not stop trying; instead, they continue to take risks to find other investors. Learning to take risks builds confidence, making it easier to speak up and share our opinions. Similarly, choosing an in-person job interview rather than an online one is more challenging, but it allows the employer to get to know you better and increases your chances of getting hired. Embracing these challenges helps us develop into stronger individuals.

Finally, setting high expectations for ourselves promotes personal growth, whereas small goals can lead to laziness. When we pursue a significant challenge, we build self-confidence and focus entirely on the task. In contrast, simple goals require very little effort. If we only choose easy tasks, we might get used to taking the easy way out and become unmotivated over time. By aiming higher, we are forced to develop new skills and expand our knowledge, which makes us better prepared for the future.

In conclusion, setting a low goal is a safe but dangerous choice because it limits our potential. It is much better to challenge ourselves with ambitious targets, even if we fail along the way. Failing a difficult task does not mean we cannot try again; rather, it provides us with the opportunity to learn from our mistakes, take bold risks, and improve ourselves. Ultimately, aiming high and failing is a much more rewarding path than achieving a simple, effortless goal.

Your attitude is one of the most powerful tools for achieving your goals and making life easier. Having a positive attitude opens up many opportunities and helps you succeed in your career, relationships, and friendships. For instance, if you support your colleagues and work hard, your boss is likely to promote you because of your dedication. Similarly, in romantic relationships, being affectionate and caring will help you find a partner who treats you with the same love and respect.

First of all, showing a positive attitude is the most effective way to advance in your career. Most employers prefer to hire and promote people who get along well with others, as this improves teamwork and company productivity. For example, last year at my uncle's company, three employees were considered for a promotion. Most of the staff voted for one specific person because he was the friendliest and most suitable for the role. This proves that when people like your attitude, they will support you and trust your leadership.

Secondly, a great attitude and open communication are essential for a healthy relationship. Most successful couples stay together because they respect each other and talk through their issues. For instance, my parents rarely argue; instead, they prefer to discuss their problems calmly. They taught me that you do not need to shout or have a negative attitude to resolve conflicts. This shows that a good attitude is the best way to keep love alive and prevent divorces.

On the other hand, some people argue that a good attitude is not always necessary to achieve success. They believe that a tough or even negative attitude can help someone build a great career. For example, the president of El Salvador has a difficult personality, yet he has had a highly successful political career. However, citizens often say they support him because they need his leadership, not because they actually like him. This demonstrates that while you can achieve power with a bad attitude, people will never truly respect or like you.

In conclusion, individuals with friendly personalities find it much easier to succeed because of how they connect with others. Conversely, those who maintain a negative attitude will struggle to make friends unless they decide to change. Ultimately, being charismatic and maintaining a positive attitude will greatly benefit your life and make your journey to success much smoother.

First impressions vary from person to person, as everyone reacts differently when they experience something for the first time. However, these initial thoughts can easily change once you learn more about someone's life. While first impressions are significant because they represent our immediate reactions, these feelings can often shift after just an hour or a day.

For instance, you might get a bad impression of a class on the first day because it seems boring, but if the second day is fun, your opinion will likely change. Often, our first impressions depend on our own mindset; if you have a negative attitude, your initial reactions will be negative as well. Furthermore, if a person reacts poorly to a bad first impression, it can reveal a lot about their character.

On the other hand, some people find it impossible to change their minds, holding onto their initial reactions no matter what. Similarly, even if you have a positive first impression of someone, your opinion can quickly turn negative if they do something bad later on.

This shift can also happen in other situations, such as a new job. On your first day, you might think the job is easy and fun, and you might even make some friends. However, on the second day, if you meet your boss and they have a bad attitude, your feelings about the workplace will probably change because you dislike their behavior. Despite this, first impressions remain crucial because starting with a positive thought about someone can help you build a good friendship.

In conclusion, first impressions can change depending on the individual and their attitude, although some people will never alter their initial thoughts. Imagine how unfortunate it would be if first impressions never changed. It would be a shame to miss out on getting to know someone simply because you initially thought they were not cool, without taking the time to understand their life.

Imagine a school program where students of different ages come together to work on projects, participate in activities, and learn from one another. This kind of initiative could completely transform our daily school experience.

Such a program would help you understand difficult subjects much faster. Many students find it easier and more comfortable to talk to peers rather than teachers. Sometimes, adults can make students feel pressured, which stops them from asking questions. Other students, however, can explain things in a simpler way because they relate to what you are going through.

In addition to academic help, this program would be a fantastic way to socialize. While we all have our regular group of friends, there are many other students in the school we have never spoken to. A shared space like this would allow everyone to connect, interact, and build new friendships with people they might otherwise just pass in the hallway.

Ultimately, this program is about creating a supportive community. It is not just about getting help; it is also about giving back. Every student has something unique to share, meaning you can teach someone a new skill one day and learn something completely different from another student the next.

If you think this program would make your school a better and more welcoming place, you should take action. Talk to your teachers or your principal and share these ideas with them. By working together, you can start something new that benefits the entire school community.

An overwhelming 89 percent of students at Generic School are against the school board's proposal to extend the school day by an hour and a half. Most students already have busy schedules after school, which include working part-time jobs, taking care of younger siblings, and completing homework. For these reasons, the school day should not be made longer.

First of all, many parents work long hours to pay bills and provide food and clothing for their families. Consequently, students must watch their younger siblings after school. While looking after siblings can be fun, it is also a major responsibility. Students have to feed them, change their clothes, and make sure they stay safe. Additionally, doing household chores while the younger children are asleep is a great way to help, ensuring that parents do not have to worry about cleaning when they finally get home from work.

Furthermore, high school is already very challenging because of the heavy workload. Students have to manage a lot of homework and difficult projects to keep their grades high and avoid failing. Working on projects and studying with classmates not only makes the work easier but also allows students to socialize and support each other. Ultimately, graduating from high school is a major goal, and students need enough time to study so they can make their parents proud.

In addition, having a part-time job is very beneficial for teenagers. It allows them to earn their own money, meaning they do not have to rely on their parents for an allowance when they want to buy things. Although working after a long day at school can be exhausting, it teaches responsibility and financial independence. Moreover, sharing a workplace with friends can make the job much more enjoyable and motivating.

I strongly believe in individuality. I think it is wonderful when people choose their own path in life and do what makes them happy. Many of my friends just follow the crowd and do what everyone else is doing, but I prefer to make my own decisions and follow my own interests. My family can be quite negative at times; they often do not want to listen to my opinions. This attitude has actually made me value my independence even more because I want to express myself and make my own choices. I know many people who rely too much on others, which I do not think is healthy.

In history class, we learned that people in the past did not have much individuality. Today, many people still depend on others because they crave attention. They worry constantly about what others think of their appearance or personality. Personally, I am happy with who I am because I know I am a good person. I do what I want and I do not care about other people's opinions.

Since I am still learning English, it is sometimes hard for me to express all my thoughts, so I want to share a bit about my personal life to explain my perspective. Two years ago, I moved here from Puerto Rico, and my life changed completely. This experience taught me to appreciate everything I have because I now understand the hard work and sacrifice required to achieve anything. Despite the challenges, I want to keep improving myself.

Adapting has not been easy because the language and culture are completely different. However, I keep pushing forward because I believe in myself and my ability to reach my goals. I have met many different people here—some have been very kind, while others have not. I love learning new things and exploring new places, but one thing really frustrates me. Even though Puerto Ricans are US citizens, many people treat us like undocumented immigrants simply because Spanish is our first language.

These past two years have been very difficult, especially at school. It was hard to sit in a classroom feeling completely isolated, unable to communicate or ask questions while watching everyone else succeed. Because I felt unsupported at school and at home, I started skipping classes and making poor choices. Today, I often feel like I do not belong here. The only reason I keep going is my mother. I want to succeed so I can give her the life she deserves, because she always did her best to support us and give us everything she could back in Puerto Rico.

Thomas Jefferson once raised an important question about whether we accomplish more by always staying active, or if inactivity also serves a purpose. People have very different opinions on this topic. Some people prefer to be lazy and do not try to move forward in life, while others want to keep moving and work hard to create new opportunities. Personally, I agree with the idea of staying active. I believe that being constantly active allows us to struggle through difficulties, exploit our time, and connect with new opportunities.

However, not everyone agrees with this point of view. Some people believe they cannot create better options for themselves because of their difficult circumstances, such as a lack of money. Nevertheless, we must understand that nothing in this life is easy. For instance, before my grandfather passed away, he told me a story about how hard his life used to be. His family was not rich, and his five children sometimes only had one meal a day. Yet, he always said that everything would change one day, and he never stopped believing it. Eventually, he found new opportunities to create a better life for his family. This taught me that if you want to achieve something, you must be prepared to struggle.

Furthermore, we can realize our greatest dreams if we exploit our time properly. By working hard, people can quickly achieve things they never thought possible, such as owning a beautiful car or a big house. Additionally, being successful gives us the ability to help other people and improve their lives. Those who never stop working are the ones who always accomplish the most.

Finally, it is crucial to constantly look for new connections and options. This means we should not stop on one street, but always try to cross over to the other side to see what is there. I once realized that if we actively search for different paths, we will definitely find them. To get what you want in life, you must step forward, because nothing will happen if you do nothing.

In short, the main idea is that you can achieve many dreams if you keep moving from one side to the other. People who do not try to go further will never experience anything different, which is sad because they will never realize their potential. However, if you work hard and always look for more, you can have everything you want. For example, if you want a car that costs one million dollars, you will be able to buy it because you worked hard and earned the money. We must struggle, exploit our time before it quickly runs out, and look for new options to make our lives better. If you do this, your life will become much easier.

While some people argue that students should be allowed to use cell phones in class for internet research and schoolwork, they should actually be banned. Cell phones cause too many disruptions in the classroom and lead to students chatting instead of listening to the teacher.

To begin with, mobile phones create significant disruptions during lessons. When students use their phones to listen to music or watch videos, they ignore their classwork and disturb those around them. This behavior can also lead to serious arguments with teachers who do not want music playing in their classrooms. If a student constantly uses their phone and ignores the rules, it can result in repeated trouble, which might eventually lead to suspension or expulsion from school.

Secondly, having phones in class encourages students to text and chat while the teacher is speaking. Instead of focusing on the lesson, they pay attention only to their screens and their friends. This can lead to inappropriate behavior, such as sharing rude or offensive pictures to joke around. Such actions can embarrass and hurt other students, damaging their self-esteem and making them feel too afraid or ashamed to return to school.

Thirdly, cell phones make it very easy for students to cheat on exams. During a test, a student can easily look up answers on their phone to get a high grade. This is unfair to classmates who studied hard. Furthermore, relying on phones to cheat prevents students from developing self-confidence and studying properly, which ultimately harms their actual knowledge and learning.

Finally, phones prevent students from participating in class discussions and activities. Instead of answering the teacher's questions, they waste valuable class time staring at their screens. This constant phone use is also bad for their health, specifically their eyes and brain. When students are always focused on videos or music, their brains cannot process other important information, making it hard for them to interact with the people around them.

In conclusion, students should not be permitted to use cell phones in the classroom. They cause major distractions, encourage chatting during lessons, facilitate cheating, and harm both academic participation and student well-being.

Today, many schools offer distance learning through online platforms and video conferencing, while others choose not to because they believe it is not an effective way to study. In my opinion, attending classes from home is not the best option for most students, and traditional in-person education is much more beneficial.

One of the main disadvantages of distance learning is the lack of immediate support. When students are at home, they do not have a teacher physically present to guide them. If they do not understand a difficult concept, it is hard to find someone who can help them right away. Even though video conferencing is a useful tool, you cannot easily ask questions or resolve doubts in the same way you can in a physical classroom. For a student to truly learn what they need to know, being directly in a school environment is the best approach.

Additionally, studying at home presents too many distractions. It is very difficult to focus on lessons when you are surrounded by television, phones, or family members, including young children. These distractions prevent students from concentrating on their education.

It is true that online classes can be a great opportunity for some people. For instance, parents who need to stay home and care for their babies can use distance learning to study and reach their goals. However, for many others, this system does not work well. Many people who immigrate to a new country have to work hard to build a better future. They often have to study and work at the same time without the support of their parents. For these individuals, learning a new language is already a huge challenge, and trying to do it from home without face-to-face interaction makes it even more difficult.

Ultimately, our future depends on our own hard work and the decisions we make today. If we do not take our education seriously, we will face the consequences later in life, as our actions always come back to affect us. Going to school every day and studying hard is the most reliable way to prepare for the future. As older, experienced people always say to encourage students: "if you want to succeed, you can."

Consequently, their grades would suffer because they would fail to turn in their assignments.

This would be a major issue because regular attendance is essential for students to pass their classes and complete the school year successfully.

In conclusion, adjusting to this new routine would be very difficult for students. Even though there would only be four school days a week, I still believe it is a bad idea. My relationship with my best friend is a perfect example of this. We first met in math class, and at the time, he did not want to talk to me or work together as partners. When I asked him for help with some difficult math problems, he completely ignored me and did not answer.

Our current strong friendship proves that initial opinions can easily change over time, and we should always give people a second chance.

It is truly amazing how much people's attitudes can change once they actually get to know you. Unfortunately, not everyone in this world is kind, and many people still choose to bully others. Instead of trying to understand someone, they judge and prejudice them without any real reason. This is the main reason why I often prefer to be by myself, as I really dislike how much people gossip and talk about others. Sadly, those who are targeted by bullies are often too frightened to say anything because they feel powerless against the people who mistreat them.

Personally, I try my best not to care about what other people say about me, as they can talk as much as they want and it is their own problem. However, some people get deeply hurt by these negative comments, and they only look for help when they find themselves in serious trouble. Whenever I feel angry or sad, I find comfort in playing soccer. It is a great way for me to clear my mind and temporarily forget about all the worries and problems I have.

If I had the opportunity, I would organize soccer matches so that anyone who wants to play can join and forget their own troubles for a while. This is the true purpose of sports: they allow people to have fun together without any fighting. There are also many other great ways to get to know people, such as going to the cinema with friends or watching basketball, volleyball, or soccer games. Ultimately, I believe that every problem has a solution. The main issue is that we often fail to show respect to one another. If we did, everything would be completely different.

Everyone deserves to live in a safe environment free from criminals and gangs, who only know how to make poor communities suffer even more. We should get all families involved to stand together and stop those who are constantly hurting others. Many people study as hard as they can because they want to achieve something in life and rescue their families from difficult situations. Finishing high school is a great way to earn money more easily and secure a decent job; even if it is not your dream career, at least it is a start.

To stay safe, people should not hesitate to go to the police if someone tries to steal their belongings, as the authorities can help them and try to recover what was lost. It is important not to show fear, because when you look scared, dishonest people will take advantage of you. We are all intelligent, but we must use our intelligence wisely in every situation. If you do not stand up for yourself and show some strength, angry people might find a way to hurt you deeply.

People can be very nice, but their behavior changes completely when they get angry, and you can become quite frightened of how they act. To avoid conflicts, a good strategy is to invite others to play sports or spend time together at the beach. This helps build strong friendships and keeps anger away. However, you should never reveal your weakest point to anyone. If you have a disagreement with your friends in the future, they might use that specific vulnerability to hurt you. Keeping your main weakness to yourself is the best way to protect yourself.

Ultimately, overcoming failure is the true key to achieving success.

I believe that a ten-hour workday is much better than the traditional eight-hour schedule. Working four days a week for ten hours still adds up to a forty-hour workweek, but it helps save a lot of time, energy, and electricity. Additionally, if employees want to earn extra money, they can still choose to work overtime on Fridays and Saturdays.

This same concept should be applied to education. Schools should extend their daily hours by two hours to create a four-day school week. This change would allow both students and teachers to enjoy a three-day weekend. By closing the school building for an extra day, institutions could also save a significant amount of water and electricity. 

Furthermore, a longer weekend would greatly benefit students' well-being and academic performance. Many teenagers struggle to wake up early in the morning, which affects their ability to study and complete their homework. With a three-day weekend, students would get enough sleep, allowing them to feel refreshed, stay active, and focus better during classes. This extra time is also crucial for high schoolers who have to balance school with part-time jobs. Many students work over thirty hours a week, leaving them with almost no time for homework on Saturdays and Sundays. A longer weekend would finally give them the necessary time to finish their assignments and achieve their academic goals.

The famous writer Ralph Waldo Emerson wrote about the importance of individuality. However, I disagree with his perspective because there are many times in life when we absolutely need help from other people. Success is not just about being an isolated individual; it is about knowing how to manage your time and your life. In this essay, I will discuss how we can cooperate with others. First, I will look at workplace relationships and teamwork. Second, I will discuss how we interact with society and why we should not be completely isolated. Finally, I will explain how we make decisions and put them into action. This will show that individuality does not prevent us from achieving our goals through cooperation.

There are many situations at work where individuality can be a challenge. For instance, you might have a colleague whose behavior you do not like. Instead of isolating yourself, you should try to cooperate with them because you might need their assistance in the future. Overcoming these personal differences to work together is a great way to connect with others. Furthermore, even if you are currently in a job that does not match your future dreams, you can still work toward your goals. Being stuck in a job you dislike often leads to isolated, negative behavior, but many successful companies show that working together as a team is the best way to achieve goals.

In society, some people prefer to be alone, and we often describe them as antisocial. They choose isolation simply because they feel more comfortable that way. Others avoid people because they prefer to do everything themselves and want to be the center of attention; these are the true individualists. However, people behave this way for different reasons, such as their personal backgrounds. Living in society can be complicated, especially when dealing with these types of people, but we can try to cooperate with them. Many of them can change for the better when they seek help or when someone close to them offers support.

We all make choices in life, and some of these decisions can lead us down the wrong path or change who we are. Trying to become a different person is a conscious choice. You can either let the world push you around, or you can make your own decisions about your future. Many people choose to let society control their lives because they think it is easier. However, even a leader like a president cannot work alone; he must cooperate with Congress because he cannot do everything by himself. Just like a president, we must decide whether to cooperate with others or try to do everything alone to reach our goals.

In conclusion, we all have the power to choose our own path in life. As discussed, this is true for our careers and how we handle workplace relationships. It also applies to how we live in society and resolve conflicts with others. Finally, I have shown how our decisions allow us to fight for our goals. This proves that Ralph Waldo Emerson was incorrect to suggest that the world constantly forces us to conform, because we have the power to change our circumstances and become who we want to be by working with others.

The British naturalist and politician John Lubbock once wrote, "Your character will be what you yourself choose to make." While some people believe that our past completely determines who we become, we actually hold the power to shape our own lives through our decisions. For instance, if someone grows up in an abusive household, it does not mean they are destined to become abusive themselves. Instead, this difficult experience can make them stronger and help them build a more resilient character.

We have the freedom to define who we are. Sometimes people might judge others quickly, calling them "mean" or "selfish," but they are often confusing temporary personality traits with deep character. Ultimately, you build your character for yourself, not to please others, because you are the one who has to live with your choices. People should not judge a book by its cover. When you focus on developing your inner strength, you can leave behind a powerful legacy. Others will notice your independence and wonder how you became so strong, and sharing your journey can inspire them.

It is impossible to build character without facing hardships. For example, if you lose a family member to a serious illness, it is natural to feel depressed and overwhelmed by grief. However, choosing to move forward and make them proud of the person they raised is a powerful way to build your character. Even when you feel sad, continuing to push through life's challenges makes you much stronger than you realize.

Everyone experiences moments of self-doubt where they want to give up because they feel inadequate. Our minds can play tricks on us, filling our heads with negative thoughts. However, focusing on these doubts will only hold us back. Character is about pushing through the obstacles and "brick walls" that life throws at us, and only we have the power to knock them down. We must trust our instincts, ignore the critics, and strive to stand out by turning what seems impossible into reality.

In the end, life is not about having everything perfectly chosen for you; it is about making the decisions that are best for your own journey. As Lubbock’s quote suggests, your character is ultimately your own creation. By embracing life and learning from every experience, you can actively build a character you are proud of.

For example, a student who plays basketball might also have to attend an after-school English club on Wednesdays. If he arrives at practice just five minutes late, his coach might give him a warning. Eventually, if he keeps arriving late because of the club, the coach might force him to choose between school and basketball. This could lead to him getting kicked off the team, ruining his chance to play the sport he loves and hoped to make a career out of.

Finally, staying late at school limits the time you have for hobbies, like playing video games. If you join this club, you will only be able to play on weekends. Because the club ends late, you might not get home until 7:00 PM after a long drive. By then, you still have to finish the homework you did not complete during the club, leaving no time for entertainment. For example, a student who is a gaming streamer on YouTube would not be able to stream on weekdays. Because of his late schedule, he would lose many of his followers and viewers. This proves that homework clubs can ruin a student's personal projects and hobbies.

It is extremely difficult to balance schoolwork with other important activities at the same time. If you love sports or hobbies, you should focus on them and do your homework in your own free time. You should avoid after-school clubs if you do not want to spend unnecessary extra hours in the classroom.

Having a positive attitude is the key to achieving success. Generally, there are two kinds of mindsets: positive and negative. A good attitude can support you in many different situations. For instance, if you disagree with your boss about your salary, approaching them with a positive attitude can lead to a mutual agreement, whereas a negative attitude might get you fired. Additionally, a good attitude helps during difficult or boring moments. If your family is having a tough time on a vacation, bringing a cheerful attitude can lift everyone's spirits and make the trip better.

There are many things that can put you in a good mood. For example, you might feel positive after a good night's sleep, when the weather is sunny outside, or when you receive a present. Going to your favorite restaurant, eating your favorite meal, having friends over to your house, visiting family, or enjoying a fun trip can also make you feel great.

On the other hand, a bad attitude can lead you down the wrong path. People who are constantly negative are often difficult to get along with, and as a result, they usually have very few friends. For example, if you go to school feeling stressed and angry, and your teacher does something you dislike, you might lose your temper and yell at them. This behavior will likely get you sent to the office and result in a bad report. Similarly, interacting with someone else who has a bad attitude can easily lead to a dangerous fight.

Several factors can cause a negative attitude. These include feeling exhausted, having too much work, or being stuck indoors on a rainy day. You might also get into a bad mood if someone else is rude to you, if you are angry at someone, or if you are hungry and the food tastes terrible.

Personally, I always have the best experiences when I maintain a positive attitude. Things like eating my favorite food, getting gifts, or spending time with my family always put me in a good mood. For instance, yesterday was my cousin's birthday party at a really fun venue. I had a great attitude because I was playing with my cousin and eating delicious food. I also feel happy when my family and I go on trips, as I love traveling and exploring new places. Another example is my science teacher; because he was in a good mood, he gave us an extra day to submit our project.

There are numerous advantages to staying positive. For example, if you study hard for an important exam and feel confident, waking up with a good attitude the next morning will help you stay relaxed and score a high grade. Ultimately, the greatest benefit of a positive mindset is happiness, which is the best feeling anyone can experience.

In conclusion, keeping a positive attitude can help you succeed in various areas of life, including work, school, and family gatherings. Now that you know this, the next time you face a difficult situation or feel down, remember that the best way to handle it is with a good attitude.

What does it mean for schools to partner with businesses? I believe it is an excellent opportunity for students to explore different career paths before entering college. Through these partnerships, students can visit companies and see firsthand what various jobs look like, helping them decide what interests them. I believe I am a great candidate for this program because I enjoy working with others, I want to discover my career interests, and I want to gain practical work experience.

First of all, while some people prefer to work alone, I truly love being around others. Interacting with people always gives me a positive energy. In any workplace, you have to collaborate with colleagues, whether you get along easily or not. For instance, during a group project at school, I initially did not know my teammates and felt nervous about speaking up. However, once I started talking to them, we became good friends. Whenever I meet new people, starting a conversation makes me feel as if we have known each other for a long time.

Additionally, many students already know what they want to do in the future, but I am still unsure about my path. I often ask myself what my strengths are, but I have not figured it out yet. Not everyone gets the chance to find their dream job, but being selected for this program would give me the perfect opportunity to discover what kind of work truly interests me. Finding my passion is very important to me because many people work in jobs they dislike just to support their families, but I believe we should choose careers that make us happy.

Furthermore, it is difficult to work at a company without knowing anything about it beforehand. I believe it is essential to have some experience before starting a job. For example, when I wanted to work in a restaurant, I did not know what to expect, so I asked a friend who worked there for advice. While some jobs do not require experience, many others do. I have always wanted to become a nurse, and being chosen for this opportunity would allow me to explore the nursing field and gain valuable hands-on experience.

In conclusion, I believe I should be selected for this partnership program. My passion for working with people, my desire to find the right career path, and my eagerness to gain real-world experience make me a strong candidate. Being around others brings me positive energy, and this program will help me choose a career I will genuinely enjoy. Having the chance to experience a job beforehand is a wonderful opportunity that will prepare me for my future.

Going for a bike ride is a wonderful way to spend time outdoors, especially during the warm summer months. When you ride a bicycle, you have the freedom to go wherever you want, which is an amazing and exciting feeling. Along the way, you can see many interesting sights, such as local shops, busy cars, birds, and beautiful rivers where people are taking photos. You can also ride past famous landmarks like museums and popular restaurants, observing the people there, or even visit a zoo to look at the lovely flowers. It is also a great opportunity to meet other cyclists who enjoy being outdoors just as much as you do.

This activity is not only fun but also very convenient. For instance, you can easily stop at a store to buy some food while you are out, or you can pack your own snacks from home to enjoy a picnic in a scenic spot. Riding a bike becomes even more enjoyable when you share the experience with others. You can take your children with you, or plan a fun outdoor trip with your friends and family. Exploring different areas together, discovering beautiful art and designs on buildings, and having a picnic makes the whole adventure much more exciting. Ultimately, cycling is a fantastic way to discover new places, learn more about your environment, and feel happy.

It is quite better because it is not only our students that are getting tired of the cafeteria menu; there are other students in different schools that are also going through this issue. Schools from different states might see us and take the same idea as you have, Principal. That is going to help not just the students; it is also helping our parents to save money, because students that don't like the menu anymore are telling their parents to buy them food from outside, and sometimes those parents don't have the money to do so. It also can help students not skip classes to go buy from outside because they don't like the food anymore. That can help the students, parents, and also keep the school from having a bad reputation.

That is going to help all students to be satisfied with the new changes that you want to do. Students are going to have their favorite food and other students won't need to skip class to go out and buy food, parents won't be worried anymore, and students are not going to take any risk of getting sick because they don't eat. Healthy food can help us with many things like our bodies: less fat and more protein are going to be in our bodies. Parents won't have to buy food for the kids anymore and they are going to save money. Changing the school menu is a great idea that most of the students are going to understand, and for the ones that don't, they are going to get used to it. That's going to help every student, and people from outside are going to see the changes in the school, and other schools should start doing the same for their students. A healthy life with less risk of everything. This is my sincere opinion, and hopefully the principal takes some ideas of what the students think and what is the best for all of us. Thank you!

Dear Principal,

Transitioning to a healthier cafeteria menu is an excellent idea. Introducing new, nutritious, and diverse food options will allow students to taste meals they have never tried before. As a student, I strongly support this initiative because having access to healthy food is highly beneficial for our entire school community, helping us stay energized and focused throughout the day.

While a new menu will make many students happy because they are tired of eating the same meals every single day, it might also upset others who prefer the current options and never get tired of them. To solve this issue, I suggest you consult with the cafeteria manager to identify which dishes are the most and least popular among the students. Instead of changing everything at once, you can keep the students' favorite meals and replace only the unpopular ones with the new healthy options. This compromise will satisfy both groups of students and make the transition much smoother.

By keeping popular items and adding new choices, students will remain happy with their lunch options. Furthermore, our school could set a great example for other schools in different states that are facing similar issues with their cafeteria food. They might see our success and decide to implement the same ideas. This change will also help parents save money. Currently, students who dislike the cafeteria food ask their parents to buy them meals from outside, which can be a heavy financial burden for families who might not have the extra money. Additionally, having better food on campus will stop students from skipping classes to buy lunch outside, which protects the school's reputation and keeps students safe.

Many students, including myself, genuinely enjoy trying different types of food and experiencing new flavors. Currently, our cafeteria does not have a good balance of healthy and unhealthy options, and we really need a change to improve this situation. Some students even have allergies to the current food selection, meaning they do not eat all day and end up feeling sick because we are not allowed to leave campus to buy lunch. Offering a healthier, more diverse menu ensures everyone can eat safely. Moreover, when students skip school to buy food outside, it is dangerous and causes unnecessary worry for parents when the school contacts them about their absence. It is much better if we can get everything we need inside the school.

In conclusion, the best approach is to work with the cafeteria manager to find out what students like and dislike. This will make the transition smooth and keep everyone satisfied. Students will not need to skip classes for food, parents will save money and worry less, and we will all benefit from a healthier diet with less fat and more protein. While some students might resist the change at first, they will eventually adapt to the new menu. I hope you will consider these student perspectives to make the best decision for our school community. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Everyone has the freedom to make their own choices and pursue the goals they have dreamed about for a long time. Nobody wants to be forced into doing things they dislike. Instead, people prefer to choose their own paths, deciding who they want to become and what they want to do with their lives.

However, the paths we choose can be either difficult or easy. The hard path requires a lot of effort, such as studying diligently to get good grades and working hard. On the other hand, the easier path often depends on having money or resources from the start. This is a quicker route, but not everyone can choose it. For instance, wealthy people can make decisions about their future much faster because they do not have to worry about bills, car payments, or other expenses. In contrast, those without much money face a longer journey. They must work extra hard and constantly worry about financial responsibilities while trying to build their future.

I once had a friend who was working and going to school at the same time. Just as he was graduating high school, he made a poor decision. He decided to stop his education because he believed that working immediately would bring in more money than going to college. Today, he works at a nail salon, where his income is unstable, and he regrets losing the opportunity to get a degree and a better-paying job. My brother made a similar mistake. He attended college for two years but then decided to quit and start working. If he had stayed in school, he probably would have found a much better career. These examples show that we must think carefully about the future consequences of our choices.

Although we are responsible for our own decisions, we often need guidance. Many people do not know what they want to do in the future or what careers might interest them. In these situations, support from family and friends is essential to help them make the right choices. Ultimately, our decisions and the environment around us shape our future. By working hard now, we can build a good life for ourselves and make it easier for our future children to make their own decisions when their time comes.

Although the truth can sometimes be painful, it is always better when people are honest with you. Even though it is tempting to hide the truth at times, pointing out when someone is doing something wrong is actually very helpful. When friends are honest with each other, they build mutual trust, which ultimately leads to much stronger and healthier friendships.

Furthermore, being truthful with your parents is crucial. If you are facing difficulties, such as trouble at school, they can only help you find a solution if they know the truth. On the other hand, if you lie to people, you will lose their trust completely, and they will always view you as an untrustworthy person. Additionally, if you do something wrong and try to cover it up, you will eventually get caught anyway. The situation will not go the way you planned, so it is much better to be truthful from the start to avoid making things worse.

Admittedly, telling the truth can be difficult because we do not want to hurt other people's feelings. However, staying silent or lying only gives them false hope. In the long run, they will appreciate your honesty, realize what they should have done differently, and value you as a true friend who belongs in their life. Personally, I would always prefer to hear the truth directly, even if it hurts in the moment. Finding out the truth later from someone else is much more painful, and it makes you feel terrible about yourself because you were deceived.

Ultimately, while honesty can sometimes be a double-edged sword, it is a vital quality to have. Surrounding yourself with honest people is much better than being lied to. Practicing honesty also prepares us for the real world as we grow older. When we have jobs and families, being truthful helps us face the challenges of life, even when things are unfair. In the end, honesty is a key tool that prepares us for whatever the future holds.

Many people believe that our current summer vacation is too short and needs to be adjusted. I agree with the idea of changing the school calendar by eliminating spring break and extending summer break so that it begins in June and ends in August. May is simply too early to finish the school year.

Schools should get rid of spring break. If we cancel this break, we can use that specific week in April for important things like taking the SOL tests or preparing for them. Instead of being away, students can spend this time practicing for their exams. Teachers would also have more time to help students study and make sure everyone is ready for their finals.

Additionally, summer vacation should run from June to August. Ending the school year in May does not make sense because the weather is often still cold. June is the perfect time to start vacation because the weather is hot and sunny, which is ideal for traveling with family, hanging out with friends, and enjoying outdoor activities.

During the week that used to be spring break, schools could also organize fun and educational events. This would be a great opportunity for students to learn new skills, play sports, and go on field trips to art museums, universities, or music concerts. This way, students can learn and have fun at the same time.

In conclusion, I agree that we should reform the school calendar. Removing spring break and extending summer to a full three months from June to August is a great plan. It gives us more time to prepare for the SOLs and final exams while allowing us to enjoy a better, warmer summer vacation.

Ultimately, spending four years in high school prepares students much better for college or the workforce. It gives them more time to learn important things and decide what they want to do in the future.

I strongly believe that staying true to ourselves is always the best choice, rather than trying to act like someone else. Being authentic means having confidence in who we are. It means we do not let just anyone convince us to change. When we trust ourselves, we can focus on our own goals. For instance, being genuine shows others our inner strength and allows us to keep growing.

In a world where people constantly change to achieve success, we must have the self-belief to resist negative influences. Society often tries to mold us into something we are not, sometimes even pushing us to become worse people. By trusting ourselves, we can stay on a better path and continue to improve. Furthermore, this positive attitude can inspire the people around us, showing them that they also have the power to stay true to themselves.

Sometimes, we encounter individuals or a changing society that try to force us to follow their lifestyle. They want us to adopt their methods for success, even when we know those methods are wrong for us. Often, when people in society try to get ahead, they do not realize that their actions are actually harming others. Because we can see these negative consequences, we should choose a different path that aligns with our own values.

It is simply unacceptable to hurt other people just to achieve our goals. Therefore, we must find a more ethical way to live our lives.

As Ralph Waldo Emerson famously suggested, society is constantly trying to make us conform. Despite this pressure, I must believe in my own ability to succeed and achieve what I want. We should not let anyone distract us from our dreams. Unfortunately, some people do not want to see us succeed; they might try to make us fail and then mock us for our mistakes. However, if we maintain strong self-trust and focus on our ambitions, we can overcome these obstacles. With hard work and determination, nobody can stop us from reaching our goals.

When we respect ourselves and stay committed to our goals, we earn the respect of others. In contrast, many people in today's changing society try to force others to conform, achieving success through disrespectful and improper means. This is why I believe it is crucial to remain independent and maintain my own values.

In conclusion, being true to oneself is the key to happiness. Even when society changes and people try to push us in the wrong direction, we must stand firm. Even if they claim their way is better, we should reject actions that harm others just for the sake of progress. Ultimately, believing in ourselves and doing things the right way is the most rewarding path in life.

Being placed in an environment that constantly demands our absolute best is one of the most significant achievements a person can experience. I strongly agree with Ralph Waldo Emerson’s ideas on this topic because maintaining our individuality is the key to reaching our personal goals. It is essential to recognize that true success can only be obtained through our own dedicated efforts. This mindset encourages hard work, fosters healthy competition, and drives us to become the best versions of ourselves. Relying on our individuality helps us build self-confidence, which in turn guides us to seek out the best opportunities to improve our lives and find the right path forward.

Working independently naturally motivates people to put in more effort and dedication. When individuals work on their own, they tend to focus on delivering flawless results to impress others and stand out in their careers. For instance, when I complete tasks without a partner, I am driven to perform at my highest level to be recognized as one of the top workers in my field. I feel excited when I work alone because I know that my success depends entirely on my own performance, which could lead to awards or special recognition. Everyone naturally desires recognition and rewards for their labor, but to earn these honors, we must demonstrate our individual capabilities and skills. Many people share this approach because working independently often leads to superior outcomes. Consequently, solo projects inspire workers to increase their output, which ultimately benefits factories and organizations by generating more resources and better results.

Although competition might sometimes reduce teamwork, it is a powerful catalyst for personal growth and overcoming challenges. A clear example of this can be seen in the workplace. When a new employee receives a higher salary or extra time off because of their exceptional performance, it can create tension among other staff members who feel it is unfair. However, this jealousy often transforms into a healthy competitive drive. Other workers start pushing themselves harder because they also want to receive those same financial rewards and benefits. This rivalry ultimately boosts the overall productivity of the workplace, as everyone tries to find innovative ways to produce more than their peers. For instance, when a worker is rewarded with free time for finishing their tasks quickly, it motivates others to find faster ways to complete their own assignments. Therefore, individual competition in a large group creates a strong emotional drive to succeed, pushing companies to offer incentives that motivate everyone to work harder and achieve their goals.

To achieve greatness and be recognized in this world, we must be willing to work hard and ignore external negativity, such as criticism or bullying. What truly matters is our own sense of identity and purpose, not what others say about us. Therefore, being in a challenging environment that constantly tests our abilities is highly beneficial. Even when facing major obstacles, we must remain patient and resilient. If we want to stand out from the crowd and achieve our dreams, we must rely on ourselves, especially since we cannot always count on others for help. This self-reliance is evident in sports like soccer. Even though it is a team sport, individual players must compete against each other to prove who is the best candidate to lead the team. The same principle applies to the business world, where aspiring managers must compete fiercely to earn leadership positions. Ultimately, becoming a successful leader requires making independent decisions and standing on one's own feet.

In addition, being in a world where we must make tough decisions and focus on our goals is the best way to demonstrate our true potential. Working individually fosters dedication, whereas group work can sometimes be negatively affected by a lack of individual effort. People who dare to be different and possess unique qualities are the ones who make a real difference in society. These individuals thrive in highly competitive and demanding environments, allowing them to influence their workplaces positively. By standing out from the crowd, they can offer unique solutions that others might not see.

This independent spirit drives progress not only in factories but also in governments and entire nations. For example, in government systems, highly capable individuals must compete with one another to achieve great things, which ultimately leads to national progress. Therefore, I agree with Emerson's perspective because individual competition ultimately leads to personal improvement and societal advancement. By pushing ourselves to the limit, we can contribute to a more successful, productive, and progressive world.

Modern technology enables us to perform numerous daily tasks without interacting with anyone else. Today, we can borrow books, buy products, and play video games without ever speaking to another human being. As a result, our face-to-face contact with others is becoming extremely limited.

However, human interaction is a basic biological necessity. For centuries, humanity has progressed by working together, yet we are now more isolated than ever before. This is why it is crucial to step away from our screens and make an effort to talk to new people.

While online shopping and gaming are highly convenient, we are becoming too dependent on them. If children and adults only interact with screens, it becomes very difficult to make new friends or meet people in the real world. We need to change these habits before we lose our social skills.

This lack of contact starts early, as toddlers are often given tablets before they can even walk. Consequently, we see young people who are constantly isolated, staring at their phones instead of engaging with the world. Whether in class or at work, they cannot focus because they are completely distracted by their devices.

Modern technology has made our lives much easier. In the past, people had to physically attend a traditional school to get an education and pursue their career dreams. Today, however, new technologies allow schools to offer online classes that students can take from home. This is incredibly helpful for those who live far away from educational institutions. Online learning provides a wonderful opportunity for people of all ages, whether young or old, to achieve their academic and professional goals whenever they have free time.

Furthermore, many parents now choose to enroll their children in online schools instead of traditional ones. There are good reasons for this choice. In a regular school, parents cannot supervise their children throughout the day. They might not know if their kids are actually attending classes, what kind of friends they are making, or if they are experiencing bullying from other students. Traditional schools can sometimes leave parents in the dark about what is happening to their children.

On the other hand, online schooling allows parents to be present while their children study. If parents are too busy with work, they can hire a trusted tutor to help guide their child. In a home learning environment, children are safe from negative peer pressure and bullying, which can cause depression. This setup also makes it much easier for parents to monitor their child's academic progress closely.

In conclusion, choosing online education is an excellent decision for both children and adults. Online schools offer many advantages, especially for adults who did not finish their education in the past. It is never too late to start learning again, and online classes allow people to study in a comfortable environment at their own pace. Personally, I would prefer to enroll in online classes rather than travel to a traditional school every day.

Should you make your own choices in life, or should you rely on experts and others to guide you? Personally, I strongly believe that people should make their own decisions. First of all, other people are not always right, and their advice might not suit your specific situation. Secondly, only you truly know what you want to achieve in life, which makes your choices uniquely yours. Finally, it is important not to simply follow the crowd. We constantly see people making both good and bad choices, but that does not mean we should copy them. Instead, we need to decide for ourselves.

One major reason to make your own decisions is that trusting what others say can sometimes lead to mistakes. For instance, would you want your best friend to make an important choice for you? Probably not, because they might be wrong, or they might not have your best interests at heart. People are human and make mistakes, and you certainly do not want to get into trouble because of someone else's bad advice. On the other hand, when you make positive choices at school or in daily life, you set a great example for those around you. Relying on others to decide for you can easily lead to difficult situations that you would prefer to avoid.

Life offers endless possibilities, but the path you take is entirely up to you. You should not let others judge your choices or interfere in your life, as everyone has the right to live how they want. If you make a poor decision, you must take responsibility for it rather than blaming someone else. This is especially true for students in school. Many young people get into trouble simply because they copy their peers instead of thinking for themselves. When students follow bad examples, they often end up facing consequences that take away from their valuable education time. Those who succeed are usually the ones who refuse to follow the crowd.

Ultimately, you are the one who has to live with the consequences of your choices. If you do not feel comfortable doing something, you should simply refuse to do it. Do not be afraid to stand your ground if you feel a decision is wrong. Before acting, it is always wise to pause and ask yourself whether your choice is truly beneficial. No one should control your life. For example, when I was starting at a new school, I was very careful about choosing my friends. I wanted to make sure I associated with people who would not pressure me into making bad decisions. In the end, no one has the right to dictate your actions; the power of choice belongs to you alone.

In conclusion, you should always be the one in control of your own life decisions. It is true that we live in a world where people frequently make mistakes, and that is completely normal because nobody is perfect. We have all made poor choices at some point in our lives. However, taking the time to think carefully before making a decision can prevent us from regretting our actions later. Do not stress too much or let yourself down; just give yourself the time to think clearly about what is best for your future.

Many people believe that schools should offer online classes and video conferencing so students can study from home. I agree with this view because distance learning is highly beneficial. It allows students to learn more effectively, produce better work, and spend more quality time with their families. Ultimately, online education provides great opportunities for students to achieve their dreams and accomplish their goals.

First of all, online classes are much more convenient because they give students the flexibility to manage their time. For instance, many students, including myself, find it difficult to balance traditional school with other responsibilities. I want to graduate and continue my education, but I also have to work to pay for my car, my housing, and other daily expenses. Because of this, I do not have enough time for homework or studying for quizzes in a traditional setting. Online learning solves this problem, allowing students to successfully work and study at the same time.

Secondly, distance learning enables students to produce higher-quality work and earn better grades. When students have more control over their schedule, they can focus more deeply on their assignments and projects. They can use the internet to research topics thoroughly and submit well-prepared homework. Furthermore, studying from home is much less exhausting than going to a physical school. Traditional schooling requires students to wake up very early and spend long, tiring hours attending multiple classes. In contrast, online learning is more relaxed, which helps students study better in just a few hours.

On the other hand, critics argue that online classes are a waste of time because students might get distracted by their phones and fail to learn. However, online learning actually offers a wonderful opportunity for students to spend time with their families. Since they are at home, they can enjoy fun activities together, such as playing sports, watching movies, or going to the cinema. This balance makes their lives happier and more fulfilling.

In conclusion, attending classes from home through online learning is highly advantageous. It helps students learn more, get better grades, and spend valuable time with their families. This flexibility is essential because it allows students to manage their busy lives, balance their jobs with their education, and ultimately reach their goals of graduating and finding good careers.

In conclusion, getting advice from more than one person is highly beneficial. It allows you to see the right and wrong paths clearly through the diverse experiences of others.

I strongly support the idea of starting an afterschool homework club. This program would help many students improve their grades and do much better in their classes overall.

Just like anyone else, students want extra support when they face difficult tasks. When homework gets too challenging, many students simply give up and do something else. However, if we have a homework club, they can stay after school to complete their assignments with the guidance of teachers.

For instance, I sometimes need extra help, and my parents have to pay for a private tutor. Unfortunately, not all families can afford this expense. By working together to create a free school club, we can support these students, and parents will not have to worry about spending a lot of money to help their children succeed.

Additionally, while students can currently stay after school with teachers, it is usually only for a very short time. If we establish a homework club, it should last longer than just 47 minutes. Having more time means students can get a lot more work finished.

In conclusion, an afterschool homework club is highly necessary. It would save parents money, help students pass their tests, and make difficult assignments feel much easier because of the support provided. Furthermore, if teachers are too tired to lead the sessions, students can help each other, allowing the teachers to rest. Overall, this is an excellent idea that will benefit many students with their schoolwork.

Music, drama, and art classes are currently optional rather than compulsory. Students can choose to take these subjects as electives based on their personal interests. For instance, if a student enrolls in an art class, they do so by choice, perhaps to earn extra credits, rather than to fulfill a graduation requirement. In fact, if a student replaces one of their core graduation requirements with an art class, they are making a mistake because art is not necessary for graduation. While some seniors with lighter schedules or juniors looking for extra credits might choose these subjects, they remain strictly optional.

On the other hand, core subjects like English 11, geometry, general math, CIS, and world history are mandatory. Students must complete these courses to earn the necessary credits and achieve the grades required to graduate. Furthermore, these required subjects include standardized SOL tests, which are a crucial part of the curriculum. Students must pass these exams during the school year, and they usually have two opportunities to do so. They need to achieve a score of at least 300 to be eligible for a retake if they do not pass the first time.

In conclusion, while elective classes like art, drama, and music are valuable, they cannot replace core academic requirements. Therefore, these creative subjects should not be mandatory. Instead, they should remain electives that students can freely choose to support their personal interests and future goals.

Winston Churchill once said, "Success consists of going from failure to failure without loss of enthusiasm." We often think we did something wrong or did not try our best to get a job, pass a test, or keep our lives in order. But why does failure play such a big role in our daily lives?

The reality of failure is not just about losing; it is about recognizing our mistakes to improve. We must understand that failing is necessary and good for us. It prevents us from repeating past mistakes because every setback is a valuable experience and a lesson that helps us succeed.

For instance, scientists often fail many times before achieving a single successful result. However, during this process, they frequently discover new things they were not even looking for. This shows that no matter how many times we fail, there is always an answer and something new to learn.

A popular topic of debate today is whether schools should adopt a four-day week with ten-hour days, similar to some businesses, in order to conserve energy and resources. Some people argue against this, claiming that longer days will actually increase the consumption of electricity for lights, computers, and smartboards, as well as water when students leave bathroom taps running. However, I believe schools should adopt this model. Extending the school day by two hours will help us conserve resources and give us more time to raise environmental awareness and improve our world.

First of all, this schedule allows us to save more energy for the future. Additionally, schools can use this opportunity to teach students how to be more mindful of their energy consumption. For instance, teachers can give practical tips on choosing the right lightbulbs for their homes, which can help their families reduce their electricity bills.

Secondly, we can focus on saving other valuable resources like water, paper, and plastic. Since students use the restrooms frequently, they can design and display posters to remind everyone of the importance of conserving water. Furthermore, by reducing the consumption of paper and plastic, the school can save money. These saved funds can then be reinvested to improve school facilities, encouraging students to be even more responsible.

Finally, adding two hours to the school day gives teachers and students extra time to work on meaningful projects. For example, they could create awareness campaigns to educate the community about climate change and environmental protection. Students could also build a website to share tips and guide people outside of the school on how to live more sustainably.

In conclusion, extending the school day by two hours is a beneficial step. It not only helps conserve energy and resources but also gives us the time needed to raise environmental awareness. Only when we become truly conscious of our actions can we work together to create a better world for the future.

In my opinion, taking classes online is an excellent idea because it saves students a lot of time. Many students have to balance their studies with work, and it is often impossible to get a perfect work schedule from employers. By choosing online learning, students can attend classes from home after finishing their jobs, which helps them feel much more relaxed. Trying to focus in a physical classroom right after a long workday is very difficult. However, studying from home allows students to eat properly and concentrate better. Furthermore, online classes free up time for other important activities, such as playing sports or socializing with friends.

Another major benefit of distance learning relates to sickness, transportation, and parking. When students are very ill, they should not go to school because they can easily spread their illness to others. Online classes solve this problem. Additionally, sick students might not be able to drive safely. In fact, not all students own cars, and those who do often have to pay expensive parking fees at school. Bad weather can also make driving to campus dangerous or impossible. Online classes eliminate these transportation worries completely.

Furthermore, online learning is highly beneficial for students with family responsibilities or disabilities. For instance, students with physical disabilities might find it very difficult to travel to school independently. Online classes make a huge difference for them, allowing them to study comfortably from home and take breaks when they do not feel well. Similarly, for students who are parents, online education makes it much easier to look after their children while attending classes. This gives them peace of mind because they do not have to worry about missing their lessons. Even though their schedules will still be busy, having the option of online classes is a lifesaver. Parents can also use the saved time to be more present in their children's lives, helping teenagers and younger kids with their own schoolwork.

In conclusion, modern technology makes our lives much easier and more convenient. By saving time and helping us complete our tasks on schedule, online learning essentially gives time back to those who have very busy lives.

The famous writer Ralph Waldo Emerson once wrote, "To be yourself in a world that is constantly trying to make you something else is the greatest accomplishment." While some people might disagree with this statement, I strongly support it because society always pressures us to alter our opinions, culture, and beliefs. To resist this pressure, we must never give up, we must love and be proud of who we are, and we must always remember our roots.

It is essential to keep being who you are, regardless of whether other people approve of you or not. In the end, the only person you truly need to please and feel comfortable with is yourself.

Secondly, it is crucial to love yourself and be proud of your identity. We all make mistakes, but these errors should not define or change who we are; instead, we should simply learn from them. Although this can be difficult, it is definitely possible. You should embrace your unique personality and features because they are what make you different from everyone else in a society that expects you to conform.

Finally, you must never forget where you come from. People who move to another country often feel forced to change their identity and pretend to be someone they are not. However, we must resist this pressure. In a world that wants you to blend in, staying true to your heritage and proving you can succeed beyond everyone's expectations is a massive achievement.

In conclusion, do not let society change who you are. You should fight for what is best for you, take pride in your identity, and cherish your background. Staying true to yourself is what makes you unique and special, and that is indeed the greatest accomplishment of all.
